We will not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, sex, age, religion, gender reassignment, partnership status, maternity, or sexual orientation. We are, by policy and action, an inclusive organization and actively promote equal opportunities for all humans with the right mix of talent, knowledge, skills, attitude, and potential, so hiring is only based on individual merit for the job. Our organization operates through a fiscal sponsor whose infrastructure only supports persons authorized to work in the U.S. as employees. raw.excerpt: About AvalynAvalyn aims to transform the treatment paradigm for pulmonary fibrosis and other serious, rare respiratory diseases.
raw.description:
About Avalyn

Avalyn aims to transform the treatment paradigm for pulmonary fibrosis and other serious, rare respiratory diseases. The company is advancing optimized inhaled formulations of established antifibrotic medicines designed to deliver drug directly to the lungs, enhance local efficacy, and reduce systemic side effects. Avalyn’s AP01 program is an optimized inhaled formulation of pirfenidone currently being evaluated in MIST, a global Phase 2b clinical trial in patients with progressive pulmonary fibrosis (PPF). AP01 has demonstrated encouraging safety and clinical activity across Phase 1b and an ongoing, multi-year open-label extension trial, with long-term data supporting the potential to preserve lung function while improving tolerability relative to historical oral pirfenidone. Avalyn’s AP02 program is an optimized inhaled formulation of nintedanib currently being evaluated in AURA-IPF, a global Phase 2 clinical trial in patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF). Avalyn is also advancing AP03, an inhaled fixed-dose combination of pirfenidone and nintedanib, designed to deliver multiple antifibrotic mechanisms through a single lung-targeted platform. By leveraging its proprietary drug-device approach and deep expertise in rare respiratory disease development, Avalyn aims to establish a new standard of care in pulmonary fibrosis through inhaled, lung-targeted therapies. For more information, please visit avalynpharma.com and follow the company on LinkedIn.

Position Overview:

Reporting to the Director, Product Development, the Associate Director, Analytical Development is responsible for leading the analytical strategy supporting Avalyn's late-stage drug substance and inhalation drug product development and commercial readiness activities. This individual will provide technical leadership for analytical method development, validation, transfer, and lifecycle management to support ongoing Phase 3 inhalation clinical studies, Process Performance Qualification (PPQ) batches, regulatory submissions, and future commercial manufacturing activities. The position works closely with internal cross-functional teams, including Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Clinical, as well as external CDMO partners, to lead and oversee analytical activities in alignment with the highest scientific, quality, and regulatory standards.

Key Responsibilities:

Analytical Development

  • Lead development, optimization, qualification, validation, and lifecycle management of analytical methods to support Avalyn’s drug substances and inhalation drug products.
  • Design and lead late-stage characterization of inhalation critical quality attributes, including delivered dose, aerodynamic particle size distribution, fine particle dose/fraction, nebulization performance, residual volume, aerosol output rate, droplet/particle size, pH, osmolality, viscosity, impurities, and degradation pathways.
  • Develop late-stage inhalation product control strategies that link analytical methods, specifications, stability programs, in-use conditions, and device performance to clinically relevant product quality attributes.
  • Define and support E/L control strategies aligned with applicable regulatory guidances.
  • Support inhalation product comparability and bridging assessments for process, formulation, device, or supplier changes across development and commercialization.
  • Define acceptance criteria needed to support regulatory expectations for inhalation medicinal products, including pharmaceutical development rationale, device compatibility, performance characterization, and lifecycle management.

Method Validation

  • Develop and approve validation protocols and reports.
  • Ensure validation activities comply with ICH Q2, USP, FDA, EMA, and applicable global regulatory expectations.
  • Resolve analytical issues arising during validation and commercial manufacturing.
  • Partner closely with internal teams to develop analytical readiness strategies for successful PPQ execution.
  • Serve as the analytical lead supporting PPQ batches manufactured at Avalyn’s CDMO vendors.
  • Review analytical sampling plans, acceptance criteria and data packages supporting clinical, PPQ and commercial release.
  • Provide technical oversight for method transfers to contract laboratories and manufacturing partners.

CMC Regulatory Support

  • Author and review analytical sections of regulatory submissions, including INDs, IMPDs, CTAs, NDA/BLA Module 3 documentation, annual reports, regulatory responses, and related documents
  • Support Health Authority inspections and information requests.

CDMO Management

  • Provide scientific oversight of cGMP analytical activities performed by external laboratories and CDMO vendors.
  • Review protocols, reports, investigations, deviations, OOS/OOT results, and change controls.
  • Ensure vendors meet Avalyn quality and technical expectations.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with cross-functional teams, including Product Development, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, Technical Operations, Manufacturing, Program Management, and other internal stakeholders
  • Provide analytical expertise supporting process development, stability, specifications, comparability, and lifecycle management.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve analytical workflows, documentation, and laboratory efficiency.
  • Develop scalable analytical systems to support Avalyn's transition toward commercialization.

Qualifications:

  • Ph.D. (or equivalent degree) in Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, or related scientific discipline preferred.
  • Master's degree with significant industry experience will also be considered.
  • 8+ years of analytical development experience supporting drug substances and inhalation solution drug products in the biotech/pharma or related industry is required.
  • Experience with inhalation drug development is desirable and will be given high consideration.
  • Strong experience supporting cGMP late-stage development and commercial manufacturing supporting inhalation products.
  • Demonstrated experience with analytical method development, validation, and transfer supporting compendial and aerosol methodologies.
  • Demonstrated success supporting PPQ campaigns and commercial readiness activities.
  • Strong knowledge of inhalation devices and aerosol characterization preferred.
  • Proven ability to effectively oversee external CDMOs and contract laboratories.
  • Expertise in developing and authoring regulatory and CMC documentation.
  • Experience supporting FDA, EMA, and/or global regulatory inspections preferred.
  • Deep technical expertise in analytical chemistry, with an emphasis on inhalation development and late-stage commercialization is preferred
  • Ability to work independently in a small biotech environment while effectively managing multiple CDMOs and external partners.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and ability to influence without direct authority, while balancing technical detail with strategic development timelines.
  • Willingness and ability to travel 10% is required

raw.title: Principal Software Engineer - Mobile Platform
raw.excerpt: Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.
raw.description:
Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Hey, g'day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you're probably keen to find out what's on offer, so we'll get straight to the point.

What you’d be doing in this role

Mobile Platform owns how Canva runs on iOS and Android. Every product team at Canva builds on top of what this group ships. Hundreds of millions of users open Canva on a phone or tablet, and the architecture that powers that experience is one of the most important technical bets the company is making right now.

Today, much of Canva’s mobile product runs as a web application inside a native app shell. We’re moving towards a hybrid architecture built around React and React Native, supported by native iOS and Android capabilities, portable libraries and shared mobile infrastructure.

The ambition is simple to describe and difficult to execute: build once, ship native-feeling experiences across iOS, Android and web.

React Native is the direction we’re taking, but this role is bigger than expertise in a single framework. We’re also interested in Principal-level engineers who have solved comparable problems through Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform or other production-scale cross-platform architectures, and are excited to transfer that expertise into what we’re building.

This is a genuinely rare problem: evolving a mature mobile architecture while the product remains live for hundreds of millions of users and hundreds of engineers continue building on top of it. The decisions made here will shape how Canva builds mobile for the next decade.

At the moment, this role is focused on:

  • Set the technical direction: Own the key architectural decisions for Canva’s hybrid mobile platform across React Native, iOS and Android, including what should be shared, what should remain native, and how those layers work together.

  • Get the new platform into production: In your first few months, you’ll turn the architecture into shipped code, with the foundations for performance, reliability and observability in place.

  • Prove it on a real product surface: Within six months, the goal is to have a React Native surface live in production, supported by stable capabilities and platform primitives that feature teams can build on.

  • Lead senior engineers through the migration: Be the architectural anchor for Staff and Senior engineers across Mobile Platform, helping them navigate difficult technical decisions as the new platform takes shape.

  • Scale adoption across Canva: In the new year, work with major product teams moving onto the platform, establishing patterns engineers trust and choose to use. Over time, you’ll become one of Canva’s technical voices on mobile architecture, with decisions influencing 800+ frontend engineers.

You're probably a match if...
We'd love to hear from you if you fit one or more of these. You don't need to meet all of them, but the more the better and if you join the team, we're invested in helping you grow.

Experience

  • Cross-platform architecture at scale: Built or significantly evolved a large-scale cross-platform mobile architecture in production. React Native and React are highly relevant, but deep experience with Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform or another production-scale cross-platform stack can also be compelling.

  • Migration at scale: Led a meaningful migration of a mature mobile product onto a new architecture while it remained live and growing. The stronger signal is changing an existing system at scale, rather than starting clean.

  • Principal-level technical leadership: Set technical direction across multiple teams where the answer wasn’t obvious, brought senior engineers and leaders with you, and had Staff-level engineers building against the direction you established.

  • Organisation-wide influence: You’ve shaped architecture beyond your immediate team, creating platforms, standards or technical direction adopted across multiple groups or a large engineering organisation.

  • Hands-on technical depth: You’re still close to the code and comfortable working through hard implementation details, not just setting direction from a distance.

  • Engineering judgement: You don’t need to arrive as a React Native evangelist. You do need to reason from first principles, challenge assumptions constructively and help make Canva’s chosen architecture successful at scale.

Technical knowledge

  • Mobile runtime: Shared-code runtimes, native boundaries, bundle delivery and performance profiling on real devices

  • iOS and Android: Deep fundamentals across both platforms and a strong instinct for where shared abstractions stop making sense

  • Mobile performance: Performance, reliability, crash monitoring and optimisation at scale

  • Platform architecture: Shared capabilities, libraries, abstractions and infrastructure used across multiple engineering teams

  • Deep fundamentals: Strong engineering fundamentals, including data structures, complexity and system-level trade-offs

Nice to have

  • React Native at scale: Deep production experience with React Native and React internals

  • System languages: Rust or C/C++ for portable libraries that run across mobile platforms

  • Open-source contributions: React Native, Flutter, Kotlin Multiplatform, Expo or the wider cross-platform mobile ecosystem

  • Mobile CI/CD: Release trains and over-the-air updates at scale

  • AI fluency: You’ve used AI tooling in real engineering work and have a view on how it changes the way mobile teams build and operate software.

About the team

You'll be joining our Client Platform group at Canva, where our mission is to ensure a delightful experience for every user on every device. Client Platform owns the foundations that every product team builds on, including Web Platform, Mobile Platform, and the user-facing surfaces of the product. Hundreds of millions of users sit on top of what this group ships. Every Canva product runs on it.

Mobile Platform is the group inside Client Platform responsible for how Canva runs on iOS and Android. We're the team of engineers who care deeply about mobile performance, who want to shape how cross-platform mobile gets built at scale, and who want to own the next decade of how Canva runs on a phone or tablet.

The work compounds in two directions at once. Every team at Canva benefits when the mobile platform gets faster and more capable. And the architectural decisions made here will outlast most of the systems built on top of them.

What's in it for you?

Achieving our crazy big goals motivates us to work hard - and we do - but you'll experience lots of moments of magic, connectivity and fun woven throughout life at Canva, too. We also offer a stack of benefits to set you up for every success in and outside of work.

Here's a taste of what's on offer:

  • Equity packages - we want our success to be yours too
  • Inclusive parental leave policy that supports all parents & carers
  • An annual Vibe & Thrive allowance to support your wellbeing, social connection, office setup & more
  • Flexible leave options that empower you to be a force for good, take time to recharge and supports you personally

Check out lifeatcanva.com for more info.

Other stuff to know

We make hiring decisions based on your experience, skills and passion, as well as how you can enhance Canva and our culture. When you apply, please tell us the pronouns you use and any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process.

Please note that interviews are conducted virtually.

About the Role
TechnoMile is seeking a Lead UX/UI Designer to lead the design and development of advanced user experiences for our SaaS platform tailored to the Government Contracting (GovCon) industry. This role combines strategic UX leadership with hands-on design, with a strong focus on agentic AI experiences where users collaborate with autonomous systems.

You will define how users interact with AI agents, ensuring clarity, control, and confidence while navigating complex workflows and data-rich environments.

What You’ll Do

Agentic Experience (AX) Design

  • Define and lead how users interact with autonomous AI agents
  • Design human-in-the-loop systems that provide visibility into AI reasoning and decision-making
  • Create interfaces for monitoring long-running agent tasks, including status tracking, alerts, and intervention points

AI Workflow & Platform Design

  • Design seamless AI-driven workflows across React-based applications, Salesforce, and Microsoft Power Platform (including Teams)
  • Create unified experiences across multiple enterprise ecosystems

Complex Data & Content Systems

  • Architect dashboards and workflows for content-heavy, data-rich environments
  • Design systems that enable AI agents to aggregate, connect, and contextualize disparate data (e.g., linking subcontract records to prime contracts)
  • Translate complex analytics into clear, actionable insights

Advanced AI Interaction Design

  • Move beyond chat interfaces to design canvas/workbench-style experiences
  • Enable real-time collaboration between users and AI agents for document editing, data analysis, and multi-step workflows

Design Systems & Consistency

  • Extend and maintain our design system (based on UntitledUI)
  • Define standardized UI components for:
    • AI status indicators
    • Confidence levels and explainability
    • Approval, undo, and intervention actions

Prototyping & Validation

  • Develop high-fidelity prototypes in tools such as Figma or Bolt to simulate AI-driven interactions
  • Conduct usability testing focused on user trust, clarity, and control over AI systems
  • Iterate based on user feedback and behavioral insights

Strategic & Collaborative Design

  • Define and drive UX vision aligned with business and product strategy
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to deliver technically feasible solutions
  • Translate complex requirements into intuitive user experiences
  • Present design concepts and strategies to stakeholders, leadership, and clients

Research & Optimization

  • Conduct user research, persona development, and journey mapping
  • Use qualitative and quantitative insights to inform design decisions
  • Continuously refine UX processes, tools, and workflows to improve efficiency and outcomes

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in UX/UI design for SaaS, enterprise, or workflow-heavy products
  • Proven experience designing AI/agentic user experiences beyond simple chat interfaces
  • Asynchronous task monitoring
  • AI transparency and explainability
  • Multi-step automation workflows
  • Strong experience designing for complex data visualization and content-heavy systems
  • Experience working across React, Salesforce, and Microsoft ecosystems (Teams/Power Automate)
  • Proficiency in prototyping tools such as Figma, Bolt, or similar
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail
  • Experience conducting user research and usability testing
  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, HCI, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Preferred Skills

  • Front-end fluency and understanding of how React components integrate with AI APIs, including streaming UI states
  • Experience in B2B enterprise environments, particularly GovCon or regulated industries
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering concepts and LLM/agent capabilities and constraints
  • Experience working with AI/ML or data science teams to translate insights into user-facing features

Who We Are:

TechnoMile provides AI-enabled cloud solutions that empower GovCon, aerospace and defense, and other government-focused companies to modernize operations. Our SaaS products help clients:

  • Optimize business development and sales processes.
  • Streamline and de-risk contract management.
  • Unlock the value of public and private data for a competitive advantage.

Today, more than 200 companies rely on TechnoMile, including over half of the top 10 federal defense contractors and the top 10 IT government contractors.

Our Culture

  • Hungry, Humble, and Smart.We foster continuous learning and career growth, offering tuition reimbursement and ongoing development opportunities.
  • Innovative.We embrace challenges and develop solutions others cannot.
  • Flexible.Remote, hybrid, and in-office options support your best work.
  • Global.With teams across the U.S. and India, we collaborate worldwide with one mission.

raw.description:
WHO WE ARE

Hook is a Creative Production Agency. With a collaborative, maker-centric team, and an emphasis on production-led design, we develop creative campaigns, short-form content, and websites for well known brands.

Our mission is to integrate creative and production to help grow brands faster. But we believe what’s most important are the people who work with us and the experience they have along the way. We want clients to think of us as the best agency they’ve ever worked with, and we want everyone at Hook to feel like this is the best job they’ve had yet.

WHAT’S AN ASSOCIATE DESIGN DIRECTOR AT HOOK?

Hook is seeking a hands-on Associate Design Director to join one of our west coast teams.

Associate Design Directors are experienced leaders who expertly use design to exceed client goals, while working within the guard rails of existing brand marketing strategies. They operate alongside creative and motion teams, providing a client-facing fluency in visual languages, to produce industry-leading advertising content for both static and animated mediums.

They are driven experts with a passion for making premium, ground-breaking work and a commitment to fostering the talents of the employees they collaborate with. They are fearless executors who elevate the work into uncharted creative territories without hesitation. They’re fundamentalists when it comes to digital design, but approach projects with rational and innovative mindsets, always mindful of how it looks and how it works.

Associate Design Directors are ready for hands-on projects at every stage of the life cycle, from brainstorming creative concepts with the project team and developing original campaigns, to participating in client presentations and ensuring deadlines are met, to producing functional prototypes and assets all the way to launch.

Conceptually speaking, Associate Design Directors have a well established process for concept development including, but not limited to, building visual presentations, storyboards and prototypes to show solutions and context to peers, leadership and clients. Executionally speaking, Associate Design Directors at Hook can confidently execute and scale their concepts. They lend expert-level technical skills and knowledge of the digital production process to pixel-perfect client delivery, on time and on spec.

While this role would oversee tactical production workstreams, the primary responsibilities will focus on strategic and conceptual visual design challenges for national and global brands/campaigns. With an existing design team in place, and opportunities to recruit additional talent, previous experience with team and project leadership within a rapid production environment will be a critical skill. Given the close proximity to marketing clients, being an excellent communicator and an overall joy-to-work-with will also go a long way toward success.

As this client is based on the West Coast, this person must have the flexibility to work around PST hours.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Demonstrate a working mastery of visual design and brand systems.
  • Execute and manage original, persuasive, conceptual and visually compelling design work with an expertise in layout, typography, and brand identity design.
  • Lead projects with a focus on complex brand campaigns and storytelling through motion design. Expertise in communicating brand narratives through storyboards and styleframes.
  • Inspire and provide mentorship to design staff toward the goal of accelerating skill progression through a culture of collaboration, experimentation and knowledge sharing.
  • Fluently speak the language of design with both clients and creatives enabling effective feedback and direction.
  • Demonstrate emotional intelligence in all meetings and communications.
  • Work closely with internal staff to ensure design work exceeds client expectations.
  • Maintain and promote an internal awareness of industry design references and standards with a strong focus on processes and tools.
  • Cultivate a sense of ownership that elevates the standards and quality of all work achieved by the designers.
  • Partner with motion leads to streamline processes to create optimal and efficient working environments for the whole team.
  • Demonstrate an ability to juggle multiple projects at the same time while maintaining clear vision of priorities, overseeing a team of designers and making sure everything is pixel perfect before facing the client.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

  • 8+ years of experience working in an advertising agency and/or recognized brand
  • Demonstrate a high level of craftsmanship in design, with experience working on design solutions for brand development.
  • Have outstanding communication and presentation skills.
  • Imaginative, collaborative, conceptual and curious.
  • Have an optimistic outlook toward client revisions, knowing when and how to offer opportunities to push boundaries creatively.
  • Generate and maintain enthusiasm for ideas within the agency as they move from concept to execution.
  • While prior experience working directly with tech brands is not a mandatory requirement, it is certainly considered a valuable asset and a significant advantage for potential candidates.
  • Be a master of Photoshop and Illustrator, fluent in Figma, as well as emerging interactive design trends (knowledge of AI image gen tools, Prototyping, Webflow, After Effects and Blender or Cinema 4d a plus).
  • Have an enthusiasm for team leadership and mentorship.
  • While this role will not be asked to manage anyone in the short-term, there will be potential for direct reports long-term. Must have an interest in eventually growing into a people manager.

WHAT ELSE

Qualified applicants will include a resume and a statement of interest that lets us learn a little more about you.

We are a remote first organization with a “work from wherever (within the US)” approach. We're a collaborative group of people who love the internet and want to create phenomenal work. Company benefits include health, dental, matching 401k, paid vacation and holidays, and more.

At Hook we value what makes everyone different, we look for the best talent no matter the background. We know that great work requires diverse perspectives which is why we strive to create a place of belonging where everyone can express who they are. Come join us!

Hook believes in compensation transparency and equity. We’ve designed a 10-level advancement framework that’s applied consistently across disciplines and departments and aligns to location-based salary ranges. This role is leveled as a L7. During the interview process we’ll review your location, skills, experience, and other relevant factors to determine where you fall within our leveling framework and corresponding salary ranges. raw.description:
For ambitious, culturally diverse, curious minds seeking booming careers, Job Duck unlocks and nurtures your potential. We connect you with rewarding, remote job opportunities with US-based employers who recognize and appreciate your skills, allowing you to not just survive but thrive.

As a lifestyle company, we ensure that everybody working here has a fantastic time, which is why we’ve earned the Great Place to Work Certification every year since 2022!

Job Description:

Job Duck is seeking an organized, detail-oriented Real Estate Closing Paralegal to support a Connecticut real estate practice through every stage of residential and applicable commercial transactions. In this role, you will help manage purchases, sales, refinances, and other property-related matters from file opening through post-closing while working under the supervision of a Connecticut-licensed attorney. You will coordinate with clients and transaction partners, prepare essential closing and conveyancing documents, monitor critical deadlines, and help ensure every file is accurate, complete, and ready to close. The ideal candidate will thrive in a high-volume environment, communicate professionally, exercise sound judgment, and remain composed while managing time-sensitive matters. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced real estate paralegal who takes ownership of assigned work and values accuracy, responsive service, confidentiality, and consistent follow-through.

· Monthly Compensation Range: from $ $1,400 to $2,000 USD.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Perform all assigned responsibilities under the direction and supervision of a Connecticut licensed attorney without independently conducting closings, providing legal advice, or engaging in the practice of law.
  • Assist attorneys and other staff with additional real estate and administrative matters as needed.
  • Provide courteous and responsive support during transactions that may be time-sensitive or stressful for clients.
  • Record time and transaction activity according to firm procedures.
  • Assist with escrow and client funds reconciliation according to firm procedures and attorney instructions.
  • Follow cybersecurity, wire transfer, identity verification, records retention, and document destruction procedures.
  • Protect confidential client, financial, and personally identifiable information.
  • Maintain accurate electronic and physical files, calendars, contact information, and transaction notes.
  • Follow up on outstanding releases, trailing documents, recording rejections, title matters, and post-closing conditions.
  • Return completed lender packages within required timeframes.
  • Track recordings and obtain recorded deeds, mortgages, releases, and other transaction documents.
  • Confirm receipt of funds and assist with wire verification procedures intended to reduce fraud risk.
  • Obtain signatures, acknowledgments, notarizations, identification, and supporting documents as directed.
  • Assemble signing packages and assist the supervising attorney before, during, and after closings.
  • Proofread documents for accuracy, consistency, completeness, and compliance with attorney and lender instructions.
  • Prepare final title policies and deliver recorded documents and closing packages to authorized clients, lenders, and other recipients.
  • Submit documents for recording or e-recording with the appropriate Connecticut municipal land record office.
  • Prepare disbursement schedules, checks, or wire requests for attorney review and approval.
  • Confirm names, vesting, property descriptions, consideration, recording information, payoff figures, tax adjustments, commissions, and other financial information.
  • Review lender closing packages and prepare Closing Disclosures, settlement statements, ALTA statements, funding documents, and other lender required materials.
  • Identify potential title defects or transaction issues and promptly escalate them to the supervising attorney.
  • Order and review title searches, property tax information, municipal lien information, surveys, payoff statements, mortgage releases, UCC searches, and other due diligence materials.
  • Coordinate with lenders, mortgage brokers, real estate agents, title companies, surveyors, municipal offices, insurance representatives, and opposing counsel.
  • Maintain closing checklists and monitor inspection, financing, title, contingency, commitment, and closing deadlines.
  • Obtain and review contracts, lender instructions, title materials, municipal information, and other transaction documents.
  • Prepare Connecticut Real Estate Conveyance Tax Return materials, including Form OP-236 and applicable schedules, and assist with submissions through myCTREC.
  • Prepare initial drafts of deeds, conveyance documents, affidavits, powers of attorney, closing statements, escrow agreements, entity resolutions, and other transaction documents for attorney review.
  • Assist with preparing title commitments, title policies, endorsements, and related title insurance documentation under appropriate attorney or title agent supervision.
  • Assist with obtaining releases, subordinations, affidavits, probate documents, entity authorizations, lien waivers, and other curative documentation.
  • Review title reports and land record documents for mortgages, liens, easements, restrictions, probate matters, ownership concerns, and other exceptions.
  • Schedule closings and confirm that required parties, funds, approvals, and documents will be available.
  • Communicate with clients regarding required documents, scheduling, and transaction status while directing requests for legal advice to the supervising attorney.
  • Open, organize, and maintain residential purchase, sale, refinance, and applicable commercial real estate files.

· Time Zone: Eastern Standard Time

· Office Hours: Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Eastern Standard Time

· Working knowledge of real estate contracts, title searches, lender requirements, deeds, mortgages, liens, payoff statements, settlement statements, and recording procedures.

raw.excerpt: Who we areKentik is the network intelligence platform for modern infrastructure teams.
raw.description:
Who we are

Kentik is the network intelligence platform for modern infrastructure teams. Unlike traditional monitoring and observability tools, we demystify complex network operations, enabling organizations to deliver applications and innovation at scale. Built by network experts to make critical insight accessible to every engineer, Kentik is the real-time source of truth that understands every network in context — from data center to cloud to the internet. This single platform unifies and correlates cloud, device, flow, and synthetic data to turn telemetry into action. Market leaders like Akamai, Booking.com, Dropbox, and Zoom rely on Kentik to run, manage, and optimize their networks.

What we do

As a Network Intelligence Advisor, you will be a key technical lead within our Professional Services team, responsible for ensuring customers successfully leverage the Kentik solution to maximize value and transform their businesses. This is an individual contributor role focused on post-sales technical engagement and the delivery of professional services offerings after the initial customer onboarding is completed.

An ideal candidate will have the ability to build genuine, lasting relationships with our technical counterparts within our existing customers. Kentik Network Intelligence Advisors are not just a point of contact; they strive to become a trusted technical friend and advisor – the person our customers can rely on to help navigate their most complex network challenges and strategic initiatives. This role serves as a "technical architect" for our customers, helping them integrate Kentik into their unique environments, solve complex technical problems, and unlock advanced use cases. An ideal candidate will also bring a "do-whatever-it-takes" attitude to help customers derive maximum value from the Kentik platform.

What you'll do

  • Lead and execute technical professional services projects, ensuring successful implementation of advanced features and integrations
  • Provide expert guidance on network observability, helping customers design and optimize their infrastructure using Kentik insights
  • Proactively dig into customer usage patterns and network data to uncover untapped opportunities to provide value. You will identify where the customer can gain more visibility and recommend specific features or workflows to help them achieve their goals
  • Help customers integrate Kentik with their own in-house tools, systems, and workflows, utilizing APIs and scripting where necessary
  • Conduct technical check-ins to maintain high success rates, share new features/roadmap, and identify new opportunities for customers to expand their use of the platform
  • Act as a champion for customer requirements, channeling detailed technical feedback and feature requests to the Product Management organization
  • Assist in identifying opportunities to expand technical documentation and collateral to help other customers succeed
  • Partner with Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams to deliver results and ensure alignment with customer goals

What you'll bring

Studies have shown that some candidates tend to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to apply if you meet most of the criteria - even if you don’t match all of the qualifications, your skills and experience could be valuable in this role!

  • 5+ years of experience in a high-tech solutions engineering, professional services, or network engineering role
  • Must be located on the U.S. East Coast
  • Strong demonstrable understanding of network and application protocols, including Netflow, BGP, SNMP, DNS, TCP/IP, and HTTP, and their use for infrastructure design and operations
  • Proven experience managing Cisco/Juniper routers and Linux servers
  • Familiarity with network observability or monitoring suites (e.g., Kentik, Netscout Arbor, Splunk, Dynatrace, Catchpoint, etc.)
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to conduct deep technical conversations with staff-level engineers and architects
  • Understanding of DDoS attacks and basic mitigation methods.
  • Technical curiosity - you have a drive to constantly ask “how” or “why” and a relentless pursuit of new knowledge and best practices
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time to interact with customers at their offices or at industry events

Nice to haves:

  • Experience with Python, Bash, Ansible, etc. for automation and tool integration
  • In-depth knowledge of one or more public cloud architectures (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Familiarity with technologies such as LibreNMS, Elastic, Grafana, and Prometheus
  • Database and/or SQL experience

What we offer

Kentik is a fully remote company that operates globally. We seek professionals that will help us thrive as an organization, and in turn, to broaden and enhance your career. We’re very thorough in the interview process to understand your skills and how they will relate to your successful growth here at Kentik. Our compensation philosophy encompasses a fair program for all in order to attract, engage and retain talented individuals who will drive our business and wow our customers.

The base salary range for this position is: $144,000 - $168,000, with an expected overall targeted earnings (OTE) range of: $180,000 - $210,000. The salary range and OTE reflect the low and high end of the U.S. range Kentik reasonably and generally expects to pay the hired candidate in this role. The actual salary offered may be lower or higher than the stated range depending on various factors, including but not limited to:

  • Experience with the skill sets required for success
  • Demonstrated competencies and potential
  • A geographic market-based approach

Come work with us

The true meaning of Kentik is visibility. We’re committed to making sure everyone feels empowered to use their voice, has a sense of belonging, and is represented at Kentik.

We don’t look for individuals who fit the culture, but those who will continue to add to the culture. We encourage everyone to apply, especially those individuals who are underrepresented in the industry: people of color, LGBTQI+ community, women, individuals with disabilities (both seen and unseen), veterans, and people of any age or family status.

Kentik is committed to creating an inclusive interview process. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please reach out to .

Come as you are!You will be working at a fast-growing, well-funded startup alongside industry thought leaders and network aficionados as we build the future of observability and set the high bar for how network operations and digital businesses should run. With a competitive salary and amazing benefits on top of the meaningful and challenging projects you’ll take on, we’re sure you’ll enjoy joining the Kentik team.

raw.description:
Position Overview

The Senior AI Visibility/SEO Strategist is a client-facing leader responsible for developing and executing enterprise SEO and AI Visibility strategies that drive measurable business growth for leading brands. This role partners closely with PartnerCentric's Client Services, Sales, Marketing, and Data & Insights teams, while serving as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, to develop strategic recommendations and maximize brand visibility across traditional search engines and AI-powered search experiences.

The ideal candidate has extensive experience managing SEO and AI Visibility projects for large, complex websites and knows how to earn credibility with both technical and business stakeholders. This is not a traditional SEO role,we're looking for someone with proven, hands-on experience leading Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) initiatives and improving AI search visibility leveraging enterprise platforms such as Peec, Athena, Profound, Goodie, or similar solutions.

This is a remote position, but candidates must reside and physically perform the work within the United States. We are only considering applicants who possess unrestricted, independent work authorization that does not now, or in the future, require employer sponsorship.

Key Responsibilities

Enterprise SEO Strategy

  • Develop and execute enterprise SEO strategies that drive sustainable organic growth and measurable business outcomes.
  • Perform technical SEO audits and deliver recommendations related to crawlability, indexing, site architecture, Core Web Vitals, structured data, internal linking, JavaScript rendering, and website performance.
  • Partner with client technical teams to scope, prioritize, and implement SEO recommendations across complex websites.
  • Lead keyword research, competitive analysis, content strategy, and search intent mapping.
  • Stay ahead of search algorithm updates and translate industry changes into actionable client recommendations.

AI Visibility & Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)

  • Develop and execute AI Visibility and AEO strategies that improve brand discoverability across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot, Google's AI Overviews, and other emerging AI search experiences.
  • Measure and optimize AI search performance using platforms such as Peec, Athena, Profound, Goodie, or similar enterprise AI visibility tools.
  • Analyze AI-generated responses, citations, competitive positioning, and content opportunities to improve brand representation.
  • Partner with internal teams and clients to create content strategies designed for both traditional search engines and AI-powered answer engines.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI search trends, tools, and best practices.

Client Strategy & Collaboration

  • Serve as the SEO and AI Visibility subject matter expert for assigned enterprise clients.
  • Present strategic recommendations and performance insights to marketing leaders, executives, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Partner closely with Client Services, Sales, Marketing, and Data & Insights teams to support client growth, new business opportunities, and integrated marketing initiatives.
  • Translate complex technical SEO concepts into clear business recommendations.
  • Build trusted relationships with both business and technical stakeholders.

Performance Analysis & Reporting

  • Monitor SEO and AI Visibility performance using Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, enterprise SEO platforms, and AI visibility measurement tools.
  • Develop reporting that focuses on business outcomes, search performance, AI visibility, and competitive insights.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous optimization through data analysis and experimentation.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with Client Services, Affiliate Strategy, Content, Paid Media, Analytics, and Product teams to deliver integrated client strategies.
  • Provide SEO guidance during website launches, redesigns, migrations, and major digital initiatives.
  • Mentor junior team members and contribute to internal best practices, thought leadership, and service innovation.

Role Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5–8+ years of enterprise SEO experience managing large, complex websites.
  • Demonstrated success working with enterprise brands and collaborating directly with engineering and development teams.
  • Proven ability to build credibility with technical stakeholders while effectively communicating with marketing and business leaders.
  • Must be Google Analytics 4 (GA4) Certified.
  • Nice to have: Adobe Analytics Certification, Moz SEO Essentials Certification, Semrush SEO Fundamentals, Ahrefs Certification,
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise SEO platforms such as Semrush Enterprise, Ahrefs, BrightEdge, Conductor, Botify, Screaming Frog, Sitebulb, or similar tools.
  • Experience using Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Looker Studio, and other web analytics platforms.
  • Proven experience leading Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) initiatives with measurable results.
  • Hands-on experience using AI Visibility platforms such as Peec, Athena, Profound, Goodie, or similar enterprise solutions.
  • Strong understanding of how AI search platforms retrieve, synthesize, and cite brand information.
  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and client communication skills.
  • Highly organized with exceptional project management skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced agency environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting affiliate, ecommerce, retail, finance, healthcare, travel, or other enterprise brands.
  • Experience with website migrations, JavaScript SEO, schema markup, log file analysis, and enterprise CMS platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted content workflows and responsible use of generative AI technologies.
  • Experience integrating SEO insights into broader digital marketing strategies.

A Week in the Life

Monday: Review client performance dashboards, analyze AI Visibility trends, and prioritize strategic initiatives with Client Services.

Tuesday: Present technical SEO recommendations to a client's engineering team and collaborate with Data & Insights to uncover new optimization opportunities.

Wednesday: Conduct an enterprise technical SEO audit, analyze AI citation performance using Peec or Profound, and develop recommendations to improve AI search visibility.

Thursday: Meet with client stakeholders to review quarterly SEO and AI Visibility performance, discuss competitive insights, and align on strategic priorities.

Friday: Research emerging AI search developments, mentor junior team members, contribute to internal thought leadership, and partner with Sales and Marketing on new business opportunities.

Benefits & Perks

  • Competitive salary with performance-based reviews and career growth opportunities.
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • 401(k) with employer match.
  • Flexible remote work with a collaborative, supportive team culture.
  • Professional development stipend and ongoing learning opportunities.
  • Generous PTO policy, including Flex Days and company-wide holidays.

About PartnerCentric

PartnerCentric is a leading performance marketing agency helping brands accelerate growth through Affiliate Marketing, Creator & Influencer Marketing, Strategic Partnerships, Organic Search, AI Visibility, and emerging digital channels.

For more than 20 years, we've helped some of the world's most recognized brands build high-performing partner programs that deliver measurable business results. Today, we're expanding beyond traditional marketing disciplines to help brands succeed in an evolving search landscape where consumers increasingly discover products and services through search engines, AI assistants, and conversational experiences.

We're a remote-first company built on ownership, curiosity, innovation, and continuous improvement. We believe the best ideas come from people who challenge assumptions, embrace emerging technologies, and continuously seek better ways to solve client problems.

If you're excited about shaping the future of search and helping leading brands succeed across both traditional search engines and AI-powered discovery, we'd love to hear from you.

The Future of Healthcare Needs You

Are you a security leader looking to make a real impact?

As a Cloud & AI Security Engineer, you will serve as the primary technical architect and hands-on leader securing our enterprise cloud infrastructure, high-throughput network boundaries, and cutting-edge AI/ML product capabilities.

In a high-growth healthcare SaaS environment handling sensitive Protected Health Information (PHI), security is both a core technical requirement and a business driver. You will bridge the gap between traditional cloud/network security and emerging AI risk management, collaborating directly with our 100+ members of the engineering and data science teams to build secure, scalable systems that earn the trust of major healthcare systems.

Here's a sneak peek of what you'll be doing:

  • Project Leadership: Manage large security projects, proactively enhance system defenses, and ensure compliance with regulations like HIPAA and the HITRUST r2 CSF.
  • Automation & Development: Develop robust and secure code for security tooling, automation, and critical integrations to improve our security posture. Drive adoption and integration of Suki’s paved path security solutions across all business units.
  • Collaboration: Partner with cross-departmental leaders in Suki to reduce the friction, increase speed-to-market and deliver secure-by-design products.
  • AI/ML Security & Risk Assessment: Conduct security assessments and red-teaming on proprietary and third-party AI/ML models, LLMs, and data pipelines (testing for prompt injection, data poisoning, training data extraction, and model inversion).
  • PHI & Data Privacy Governance: Implement guardrails to prevent PHI exposure in model training, vector databases, RAG architectures, and fine-tuning datasets.
  • Cloud Posture & Architecture: Own the technical security architecture across our multi-cloud footprint (AWS / GCP / Azure), ensuring zero-trust principles and robust Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM).
  • Container & IaC Security: Secure Kubernetes clusters, container registries, and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform / CloudFormation) within CI/CD deployment pipelines.
  • Identity & Access Management (IAM): Design and enforce least-privilege IAM policies, role-based access controls (RBAC), just-in-time (JIT) provisioning, and secrets management across cloud environments.
  • Zero Trust & Network Segmentation: Design and enforce microsegmentation, VPC architecture, SASE/VPN solutions, and strict network isolation for multi-tenant health data architectures.
  • Egress/Ingress Monitoring: Manage network security controls, intrusion detection/prevention systems (IDS/IPS), and Web Application Firewalls (WAF) to prevent unauthorized data exfiltration.
  • Network Security Mastery: Proven track record in cloud network design, VPC routing, cloud firewalls, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), and egress control.

What we're looking for:

  • 7+ years in Information Security, with 1+ years evaluating and remediating AI risk
  • Hands-on experience securing AWS, GCP, or Azure environments using automated tools and native security services.
  • Strong coding skills for developing secure tooling, automation, including leveraging agentic AI.
  • Deep understanding of healthcare compliance standards and security protocols, including HIPAA / HITECH, HITRUST CSF, and NIST including a foundational understanding of NIST AI RMF in a cloud environment (GCP preferred).
  • Demonstrated leadership ability with experience managing security projects and mentoring junior team members.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills to lead technical discussions.

What Makes Suki, Suki

  • A mission that matters: Suki is making healthcare technology invisible and assistive—so clinicians can focus fully on patient care.
  • A product that delivers: Our AI is used by real clinicians at real health systems — and it works.
  • A team that gets it: We’re former Googlers, Apple engineers, Stanford docs, and healthcare veterans.
  • Backed by believers: We’ve raised $165M from top VCs like Venrock, First Round, Flare, and March Capital.
  • On a roll: Named by Fast Company as the Next Big Thing in Tech.
  • Best Leadership Team by Comparably. Technology Innovation Award by Frost & Sullivan.
  • Massive market: We’re disrupting a $30B+ industry, and our momentum is real.

More Than Just a Job You’ll join a team of mission-driven builders who care deeply about what we do and how we do it. We believe in showing up with empathy, iterating constantly, and always putting clinicians first. We’re committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities we serve — and to creating a culture of inclusion, belonging, and bold ambition.

To all recruitment agencies: Suki does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Suki (or any related) jobs alias or directly to any Suki employees. Suki will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Suki is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are dedicated to building a company that fosters inclusion and belonging and reflects the diverse communities we serve across the country. We know we are stronger this way and we look forward to growing our team with these shared values.

In compliance with the State of California Pay Transparency Law, the base salary range for this role is between $150k - $200k in CA. This range is not inclusive of any discretionary bonus or equity package. When determining a candidate’s compensation, we consider a number of factors including skillset, experience, job scope, and current market data.

Description

The Project Coordinator works with Project Managers, Clinical Trial Managers, Site Selection Team and Clinical Research Associates (CRA) to provide administrative and coordinating support for site activation activities and other site level deliverables through all phases of the clinical trial lifecycle. As a Project Coordinator, you will take the lead to ensure timeframes, targets and the quality of the deliverables are in line with internal and external customer expectations

This role is perfect for you if:

  • You have an experience in project administration and clinical research;
  • You want to work in a collaborative environment;
  • You want to have an impact in a fast-growing company.

﻿RESPONSIBILITIES

More specifically, the Project Coordinator:

  • Prepare Investigator Sites to conduct clinical trials through the review and approval of essential clinical trial and regulatory documents.
  • Establishes site activation timelines with selected sites and coordinates activities to meet planned activation timelines.
  • Communicate with clinical sites during site start-up.
  • Collaborates with other functional departments to ensure alignment of activities to meet site activation targets.
  • Escalates to the Project Manager risks to site activation schedule.
  • Communicates directly with the study teams, external site staff, to ensure tasks and priorities are aligned to the defined study timelines.
  • Collects, reviews and files sites essential documents.
  • Ensures essential documentation is complete and of good quality to successfully first pass review for site activation.
  • Ensures that the electronic Trial Master File (eTMF) contains the relevant regulatory documents for site activation and ongoing study management.
  • Collects and distributes documents from / to sites.
  • Produces meeting minutes from project meetings.
  • Maintains ADI log.
  • Assigns documents for internal project-specific training and coordinates training reconciliation and documentation.
  • May assist with drafting of study documents and study plans for clinical trials.
  • Acts as a main point of contact for all site correspondences for non-protocol related issues.
  • Assists sites with local ethics submissions.
  • Assist internal and external teams with access to study-specific systems
  • Assist with initiating and maintaining study files.
  • Assist with assembling and shipping the Investigator’s Study File.
  • Maintains project timeline dates, enrolment tracking tools, and study material inventory.
  • Prepares shipments of study supplies to clinical sites, when applicable.
  • Assists with preparation of Investigators’ Meeting.
  • Distributes study correspondence to sites.
  • Serves as in-house contact to support CRAs when traveling.
  • Reviews and reconciles investigators site and vendor payments.
  • Assists with project tracking activities and status reports preparation.
  • Participates in various administrative tasks as required to accomplish the goals of the project and the needs of the project team.
  • May support Health Authority inspection and pre-inspection activities.
  • May support audit preparation & Corrective Action / Preventative Action preparation for project related issues.
  • May perform project management duties on designated trials.

Requirements

IDEAL PROFILE

  • Bachelor’s degree in a field relevant to clinical research or equivalent experience;
  • Specialized graduate diploma in drug development is an asset;
  • Experience in clinical research and in the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and/or CRO industry, an asset;
  • Excellent oral and written skills in English, French is an asset;
  • Excellent knowledge and competency in Word, Excel and Power Point;
  • Ability to prioritize different assignments and work under pressure;
  • Attention to detail and meet timelines;
  • Quick learner, good adaptability and versatile;
  • Strong organizational, communication, problem-solving and multi-tasking skills.

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability, and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Permanent full-time position
  • Flexible schedule
  • Vacation
  • Home-based position
  • Ongoing learning and development

About Indero

Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale.

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

Indero only accepts applicants who can legally work in Romania.

your opportunity:

Make a real difference in the blockchain industry! Build the change you want to see.

Cardano's on-chain governance is live, and the decisions being made now are shaping the ecosystem for years to come. The Cardano Foundation is one of its most visible participants, as a DRep, as a facilitator, and as contributor to a functioning decentralised governance model.

We are looking for an agile EcosystemGovernance Coordinator to work within our Governance Team and build the Foundation's governance engagement into a standing capability. The ideal candidate combines structured execution with true fluency in Cardano governance, bringing a clear grasp of what DReps, SPOs, and the Constitutional Committee each influence. As a politically adept relationship-builder, you know how to represent the foundation authentically. You are energized by the Cardano community and firmly believe that governance credibility is earned through daily consistency, not announcements.

You will have the following responsibilities:

Community outreach and DRep engagement

  • Run the Foundation's DRep communications: newsletter, community calls, and forum presence, on a cadence the community can rely on.

  • Revive and grow the Foundation's presence in DRep and delegator discussions across X, Discord, and the Cardano forum.

  • Represent the Foundation's published governance positions clearly and accessibly to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

Stakeholder relationships and coalitions

  • Build and maintain working relationships across the governance landscape: DReps, Stake Pool Operators, Constitutional Committee members, and ada holders.

  • Coordinate internally with colleagues who own the SPO relationship so the Foundation speaks with one voice.

  • Help build durable coalitions around Foundation-aligned positions, grounded in education, alignment, and genuine participation.

Governance strategy support

  • Support the evolution of the Foundation's governance strategy and its DRep thesis.

  • Help draft and shepherd governance-related CIP and CPS submissions and constitutional amendment work.

  • Contribute to the Foundation's governance positions: the published priorities and principles that govern how we vote.

Operational backbone

  • Own meeting notes, action tracking, and the decision log so governance work does not depend on anyone's memory.

  • Provide support to the Foundation's Governance Advisory Team.

  • Track governance actions end to end, from submission through to enactment, and keep internal stakeholders informed.

your story:

  • Governance literacy: you can explain CIP-1694 mechanics and the real dynamics between DReps, SPOs, and the Constitutional Committee.

  • Execution and follow-through: you run things on cadence and close loops without being chased.

  • Communication and community-building: you write well and you build trust in public.

  • Political judgment and discretion: you sense the optics dimension before it becomes a problem.

  • Learning velocity: this ecosystem moves, and so do you.

  • AI fluency: leveraging AI capabilities and digital tools to augment your workflows and unlock new operational efficiencies.

  • 3-6 years of experience in governance coordination, community management, programme management, or stakeholder relations, ideally within a blockchain, open-source, or member-driven organization.

  • Working fluency in the Cardano governance landscape (CIP-1694, DReps, SPOs, the Constitutional Committee, treasury), enough to act on direction with limited hand-holding.

  • Proven ability to launch, manage, and sustain high-engagement initiatives, including newsletters, community call series, and collaborative working groups.

  • Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to make complex governance topics readable.

  • A proven system for tracking commitments across multiple stakeholders (be prepared to walk us through your approach when applying for the role!).

  • Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy in a fully remote, internationally distributed team.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally (roughly 4–6 international trips per year) for summits, community events, and team gatherings.

your impact:

  • Operational Excellence: DRep outreach runs like clockwork, while newsletters and community calls deliver on a dependable, high-quality cadence, solidifying the Foundation as an active, credible voice in governance discussions.

  • Strategic Maturity: You will refine and sharpen the Cardano Foundation’s DRep profile, establishing clear, well-articulated voting positions and elevating our presence.

  • Deep Ecosystem Integration: You will convert initial introductions into thriving, active working relationships with Governance Action proposers, the Constitutional Committee, Stake Pool Operators (SPOs) and ada holders.

  • Radical Transparency & Accountability: Governance decisions will be meticulously documented. By keeping decision logs current and action items tracked, you will ensure any colleague can easily understand why the Foundation voted the way it did.

nice to have:

  • Regional or cultural fluency beyond Europe, particularly with the Japanese Cardano community. While Japanese fluency is not required, it is highly desirable.

  • An analytical eye for voting dynamics and delegation data.

  • Prior experience in another L1/L2 on-chain governance ecosystem (Polkadot, Optimism, Arbitrum, Cosmos, or similar).

  • Experience supporting a board, council, or advisory body as a secretariat.

  • Additional languages.

Salary range:The expected annual fixed pay range for this role in Germany and Ireland is EUR 70,000 to EUR 100,000. The final offer will depend on relevant skills, qualifications, experience, and responsibilities.

raw.description:
About Wunderkind:

Wunderkind ads are 'behaviorally triggered', meaning that ads are served on a premium list of publishers only when a user is done consuming content. Our proprietary tag is integrated directly on the publisher page to track on-site user behavior - making 'net new' ad placements. How we serve the ad is why we are different from our competitors in-market.

Rather than placing an ad in front of someone while they're actively trying to read content, our technology patiently waits until a visitor has stopped reading before rendering our ad on the page. And that patience pays off -- it turns out that when an ad experience respects the user's reason for visiting a page, the user respects the ad experience in return. This unique, brand safe approach to ad experience gives an advertiser's message more attention and greater engagement.

About the Role:

Wunderkind is looking for a top-performing Programmatic Sales Director to work a specified list of agency, trading desk, brand and DSP accounts across the USA Central region. We are looking for someone with a proven track record of revenue growth and has healthy client relationships, particularly within accounts located in Minnesota, Ohio, Kansas, and Texas.

  • Building relationships with multiple layers of decision makers in the programmatic buying cycle (in-house marketers, agencies, and trading desks)

  • Extensive experience in the programmatic industry with a track record of successfully impacting business growth
  • A robust network of contacts across the buy side with whom you’ve built rapport and trust
  • Experience working with DSPs, ad exchanges, ad servers, and other optimization platforms is a plus
  • Experience selling CPA, CPC, and CPM marketing campaigns
  • Motivated, tenacious, and resourceful
  • Persuasive and compelling
  • Comfortable in a high-growth environment where roles and responsibilities may shift
  • Entrepreneurial spirit with a passion for the marketing technology space and a healthy dose of humility

The base salary range for this role is $140,000.00 to $150,000.00.   • Create and publish social media content, including feed posts, Stories, Reels, TikTok videos, and other short-form content.
  • Develop content that reflects each brand's unique tone, audience, positioning, and content pillars.
  • Repurpose existing marketing collateral and assets into engaging social and digital content.
  • Coordinate with business teams and relevant stakeholders to source photos, videos, promotions, events, and other content.
  • Maintain and regularly update Google Business Profiles, including photos, opening hours, posts, and Q&A.
  • Ensure content is timely, relevant, engaging, and aligned with business objectives.

Content Management & Organisation

  • Maintain a central content library using SharePoint, OneDrive, or an equivalent platform.
  • Organise content into clear categories such as raw photos/videos, team content, client content, products, events, UGC, promotions, content to be edited, ready-to-post content, and published content.
  • Review and organise content provided by business teams.
  • Select suitable content and transform it into polished marketing assets.
  • Regularly audit existing content to identify opportunities for reuse and repurposing.
  • Maintain an efficient workflow from content collection through to publication.

Brand & Creative Management

  • Create content using approved Canva brand kits, templates, colours, fonts, and logos.
  • Maintain consistent visual identity and messaging across all channels.
  • Adapt content appropriately for different brands, audiences, and platforms.
  • Ensure all content follows applicable brand, advertising, and compliance requirements.
  • Review relevant campaign and promotional materials and incorporate approved assets into local content strategies.
  • Ensure no unapproved artwork, filters, edits, or alterations are applied to branded or campaign assets.

UGC & Creator Partnerships

  • Identify and build relationships with relevant local content creators and influencers.
  • Research creators based on audience, engagement, location, platform, and brand relevance.
  • Maintain an organised creator database covering contact details, platforms, followers, engagement, location, offers, content received, and results.
  • Coordinate UGC opportunities and creator collaborations.
  • Build relationships with complementary local businesses for cross-promotions, giveaways, and collaborative content.
  • Organise and maintain creator- and partner-generated content for future use.

Local Events & Community Engagement

  • Identify relevant local events, markets, sporting activities, and community opportunities.
  • Coordinate with relevant stakeholders on agreed promotional events and activities.
  • Develop content before, during, and after local events.
  • Repurpose event content across multiple social media channels.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen local brand awareness and community engagement.

Marketing Coordination

  • Coordinate with relevant local partners and community organisations to maximise marketing opportunities.
  • Where applicable, liaise with shopping centres and other local partners regarding EDMs, newsletters, social media, digital screens, and promotional opportunities.
  • Coordinate monthly promotions and campaigns for relevant local marketing opportunities.
  • Support the preparation of marketing artwork and promotional materials as required.

Reviews & Reputation Management

  • Develop and maintain a consistent process for encouraging positive customer feedback and public reviews.
  • Monitor relevant review platforms and identify opportunities to strengthen online reputation.
  • Repurpose strong customer reviews and testimonials into engaging social media content.
  • Create review-based content such as graphics, Reels, testimonial posts, and other social assets.
  • Support customer engagement and retention initiatives.

Paid Advertising

  • Set up and manage paid Facebook and Instagram campaigns.
  • Develop and test audiences, creatives, and campaign variations.
  • Manage advertising budgets and monitor campaign performance.
  • Optimise campaigns based on performance and business objectives.
  • Focus on measurable outcomes such as enquiries, leads, and bookings, rather than reach and impressions alone.
  • Use performance data to identify opportunities for improvement.

Lead & Enquiry Management

  • Monitor dedicated enquiry inboxes and social media DMs.
  • Respond to and follow up on customer enquiries in a timely and professional manner.
  • Support the conversion of enquiries into bookings or other desired actions.
  • Track enquiry volume and conversion performance by brand and channel.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey from social engagement through to conversion.

Monthly Content Planning

  • Develop and maintain a monthly content calendar for each assigned brand.
  • Plan content around upcoming campaigns, promotions, events, collaborations, product or service focuses, and other key marketing priorities.
  • Coordinate content requirements with relevant stakeholders in advance.
  • Ensure content is prepared and scheduled consistently across channels.

Reporting & KPIs

  • Prepare a simple monthly marketing and social media report for each assigned brand.
  • Track key performance indicators, including:
    • Follower growth
    • Reach
    • Engagement
    • Saves and shares
    • UGC activity
    • Creator and partnership activity
    • Review growth
    • Enquiries
    • Bookings
    • Conversion rates
    • Revenue, where measurable
  • Analyse performance to identify which activities are contributing to business results.
  • Make recommendations and adjust content and marketing activity based on performance insights.

Proactive Growth & Systems Building

  • Proactively identify gaps in current marketing, engagement, content, and reporting processes.
  • Research, test, and implement practical solutions rather than waiting for direction.
  • Identify tools and systems that could improve marketing efficiency and customer engagement.
  • Develop repeatable processes and workflows where none currently exist.
  • Bring forward ideas for new creator partnerships, local events, content opportunities, campaigns, and engagement initiatives.
  • Take ownership of building practical marketing solutions using available systems and tools.

What We're Looking For

  • 2–3+ years of experience in social media management, content coordination, digital marketing, or a similar role.
  • Demonstrated experience managing business accounts across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.
  • Strong experience creating social media content, including Reels and short-form video.
  • Experience planning and managing paid Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns.
  • Understanding of audience testing, creative testing, campaign optimisation, and budget management.
  • Strong Canva skills with the ability to create polished, on-brand marketing materials.
  • Basic video editing skills for Reels, TikTok, and other short-form content.
  • Experience managing a shared content library and digital content workflow.
  • Experience with SharePoint or OneDrive is preferred.
  • Experience sourcing and managing influencers, UGC creators, or content partnerships is highly desirable.
  • Ability to manage multiple brands, audiences, and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain brand consistency.
  • Excellent written English and professional communication skills.
  • Experience working with a regulated or compliance-focused industry such as health, aesthetics, beauty, wellness, financial services, or professional services is highly regarded.
  • Previous experience supporting an Australian business or working in an offshore/BPO environment is an advantage.
  • Strong initiative, problem-solving skills, and the ability to independently research and implement solutions.

Systems & Tools

Experience with the following platforms and tools is preferred:

  • Canva
  • Microsoft 365
  • SharePoint / OneDrive
  • Google Business Profile
  • Meta Business Suite
  • Facebook / Instagram Ads Manager
  • TikTok Ads Manager
  • LinkedIn
  • Microsoft Excel
  • Social media scheduling and reporting platforms

Working Arrangements

  • Full-time, dedicated offshore position.
  • Remote work from the Philippines.
  • Working hours aligned with Australian business hours, with sufficient overlap during AEST for regular communication with stakeholders.
  • Australian public holidays are not required to be worked.
  • Regular check-ins with the client and relevant stakeholders.
  • This is a dedicated resource role, with the successful candidate focused exclusively on the assigned brands and business activities during working hours.

Why Join This Role?

  • Work with a growing Australian business across multiple brands and industries.
  • Take ownership of social media and growth marketing initiatives from strategy through execution.
  • Work closely with senior stakeholders and contribute directly to business growth.
  • Have the opportunity to build marketing systems and processes from the ground up.
  • Gain exposure to multiple brands, audiences, and growth initiatives.

Confidentiality & Compliance

The successful candidate will be expected to:

  • Maintain strict confidentiality of company, brand, customer, and marketing information.
  • Follow all applicable advertising, content, and brand compliance requirements.
  • Handle customer enquiry and social media data responsibly.
  • Use authorised systems and platforms when handling company and customer information.
  • Maintain appropriate access controls for brand assets and customer data.
  • Ensure brand and customer information is not disclosed, copied, or retained outside authorised systems.
