raw.excerpt: DescriptionKeeper Security is hiring a highly experienced Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our Privileged Access Management (PAM) team.
raw.description:
Description

Keeper Security is hiring a highly experienced Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our Privileged Access Management (PAM) team. This is a 100% remote position, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the El Dorado Hills, CA or Chicago, IL metro areas.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help ensure the quality, reliability, and security of Keeper’s enterprise privileged access management platform.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at .

About the Job

As a Senior SDET on the PAM team, you will architect and build automation systems that validate complex, security-sensitive access workflows across cloud infrastructure, identity providers, and enterprise environments. This role focuses on automation framework design, CI/CD integration, and system-level quality, not manual testing or security engineering. You will partner closely with software engineers, product teams, and security stakeholders to ensure PAM features are reliable, scalable, and automation-ready from the ground up.

Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for PAM workflows
  • Build reusable automation libraries for API, integration, and end-to-end testing
  • Develop automation for privileged access workflows including credential rotation, access provisioning, and session management
  • Automate authentication and identity flows such as OAuth, SAML, and SSO
  • Validate access workflows across protocols such as SSH, RDP, and similar mechanisms
  • Build and maintain automation for backend services, APIs, and cloud-hosted systems
  • Integrate automated test execution into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar tools
  • Manage containerized test environments using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Investigate automation failures, perform root-cause analysis, and improve long-term stability
  • Collaborate with Engineering, QA, Security, and Product teams to embed testability into system design
  • Contribute to quality engineering standards and automation best practices across the organization
  • Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or similar platforms to support test development, debugging, root-cause analysis, documentation, and workflow efficiency

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in test automation, quality engineering, or software development in test
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Proven experience designing and building automation frameworks or test systems
  • Hands-on experience with modern automation tools such as Playwright or Pytest
  • Strong experience testing APIs, distributed systems, and security-sensitive workflows
  • Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with containerized or cloud-native environments, including Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS
  • Understanding of authentication and identity concepts such as OAuth, SAML, and identity providers
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex system interactions and automation failures
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to influence quality practices across teams
  • Ability and willingness to use AI-assisted tools effectively to improve test automation, debugging, technical analysis, and documentation
  • Due to this role’s involvement with FedRAMP compliance requirements, qualified candidates must be a U.S. Person

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing privileged access management or identity-centric security products
  • Familiarity with cloud or security automation frameworks
  • Exposure to remote access protocols such as SSH, RDP, and VNC
  • Experience contributing to automation metrics or observability systems

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
  • Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401K (Roth/Traditional)
  • A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)

Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Classification: Exempt

Keeper Candidate Privacy Notice

This notice explains how Keeper Security processes your personal data during recruitment. Depending on the role and location, the Controller of personal data (the organization responsible for determining why and how personal data is processed) will be Keeper Security Inc. (US), Keeper Security EMEA Ltd. (Ireland), or Keeper Security APAC K.K (Japan).

1. Data We Collect

Information You provide:

  • Contact details, CV/resume, cover letter
  • Employment history, qualifications, work eligibility
  • Application responses and uploaded documents

Information We generate:

  • Interview notes, assessments, communications
  • Scheduling information

Information From Others:

  • Recruiter/referral information who submit your profile
  • References (with your consent, before final offer)
  • Public professional profiles
  • Background verification (post offer)

Voluntary Diversity and Equal Opportunity Information

  • We may ask you to voluntarily provide diversity information including race/ethnicity, gender, disability status and veteran status (US). Providing this information is optional and Keeper collects this data in order to comply with EEOC and similar requirements

2. How We Use Your Data

  • Assess your application and suitability
  • Manage interviews and recruitment workflow
  • Consider you for other/future roles (we may seek your consent to keep your information on our systems beyond the retention period specified)
  • Comply with employment law obligations

3. Legal Basis

  • Legitimate Interests (recruitment management, security and integrity of the hiring process)
  • Contracting steps (for progressed candidates)
  • Legal and regulatory compliance obligations; explicit consent where required

4. Who We Share Information With

Internal:

  • HR, hiring managers, interviewers*, IT support for system administration

*Note - diversity and equal opportunity data is not shared with hiring managers.

Third Parties:

Service providers who assist with:

  • Applicant tracking, recruitment systems and assessment providers
  • Background verification vendors (post offer)
  • Recruitment agencies (where applicable)
  • Tools to support communication, collaboration and to securely store your data

Keeper ensures that all our third parties are contractually bound to protect your personal data with adequate safeguards in place.

5. International Transfers

Your data may be accessed by Keeper entities globally as needed for the purposes of hiring and decision making. We protect any such data transfer between Keeper entities using appropriate safeguards under applicable data protection laws.

6. Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, consistent with our industry leading security standards.

7. Retention

We keep your data for 24 months from your last application activity, then delete or anonymize it.

Exceptions:

  • You opt into our talent database for further retention by providing consent (extended retention)
  • You're hired (transfers to employee records)

8. Your Rights

You have the following rights and can contact us at the email below to exercise them:

  • Access, correct, or delete your data, subject to applicable law and retention requirements
  • Object to or restrict processing
  • Withdraw consent (where applicable)
  • Request data portability
  • Lodge a complaint with your data protection authority

If you become an employee, your rights regarding your employee record are governed by our internal Employee Privacy Notice and certain data will be retained as required under relevant laws such as employment or tax law.

When you request access to your personal data, some information may be redacted if it includes the personal data of other individuals or information that we must protect in order to preserve their privacy rights.

9. Automated Decisions

Keeper does not make hiring decisions using solely automated processing.

10. Contact - Candidates can send privacy questions to:

raw.excerpt: About RemoteRemote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease.
raw.description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

About this role

We are looking for a senior partnerships leader to own the commercial success and ongoing relationship with a portfolio of Remote’s most strategic embedded partners.

This person will be responsible for driving bookings & ARR across partner-sold and partner-sourced motions (quota carrying). They will own the revenue line for these partnerships and will be accountable for making the partnerships successful commercially, operationally, and strategically.

The role sits at the intersection of partner relationship management, sales leadership, go-to-market execution, and cross-functional orchestration. The primary focus is commercial: helping partners generate demand, enable their sellers, close deals, improve conversion, and build repeatable motions that allow them to sell Remote products increasingly independently. At the same time, this person will be the senior relationship owner for the partner, responsible for partnership health, executive engagement, issue resolution, and long-term expansion.

This is not a “manage the partner relationship and hope revenue follows” role. It is a commercial leadership role where the partnership relationship exists in service of revenue growth, partner independence, and long-term embedded success.

What you bring

  • Exceptionally sharp business judgement. You can understand the business objectives and stakeholder dynamics of a complex partner organization, and translate that to concrete actions.
  • Excellent communicator and evangelist. You can create and consistently communicate the partnership value message within the partner organization and Remote.
  • Strong operating rigor: you can turn ambiguity into repeatable plans, cadences, and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong executive presence: you feel comfortable dealing with C-level execs.
  • Dare to dive deep: you operate cross-functionally with ease; you don’t shy away from detailed discussions with product, engineering, legal or compliance.
  • Deal maker: you create proposals ‘you can say yes to’ that create long term sustainable economics for both parties. You are able to be firm when needed.
  • Manage through influence: you are able to work with large strategic partners where success depends on influencing another company’s sales, marketing, product, and leadership teams.
  • Experience building, hiring and managing a high-performance team.
  • Willingness to travel 20–40%.
  • Experience owning revenue motions and owning a number. You own outcomes.
  • Experience in top-tier consulting, finance, or big tech - and in B2B tech startups/scaleups. You have the big and the small.
  • Experience building and operating new businesses, product, or sales motion. You build new systems, don’t just operate within them.
  • Bonus points for experience in HR Tech, Fin Tech, or Embedded partnerships.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own commercial outcomes for strategic embedded partners
  • Own a portfolio of Remote’s largest embedded HR technology partnerships.
  • Carry an annual bookings target of $10M+.
  • Be accountable for the commercial performance of the partnership, including pipeline generation, conversion, bookings, ARR, ASP, retention, and expansion.
  • Build and execute partner account plans that translate strategic partnership potential into measurable revenue outcomes.
  • Identify where revenue is blocked, where and why performance is below potential, and what needs to change across partner GTM, Remote GTM, product, process, enablement, pricing, or operations.
  • Manage commercial exceptions, pricing escalations, deal support, and channel conflicts where needed.

Make partners independently successful

  • Help partner sellers become increasingly independent in generating, qualifying, selling, and closing Remote opportunities.
  • Build repeatable partner sales motions across partner-sold, partner-sourced, and co-sold opportunities.
  • Work with partner sales leaders to embed Remote into their teams’ priorities, workflows, sales processes, and incentives.
  • Partner with enablement, solutions consulting, partner marketing, and embedded sales teams to ensure partner sellers know what to sell, how to sell it, and when to bring Remote in.
  • Drive a clear path from Remote-supported selling to partner-led selling, with the goal of reducing unnecessary dependency on Remote while improving commercial outcomes.

Lead senior partner relationships

  • Own the overall relationship health with strategic embedded partners.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior / C-level stakeholders within the partner organization across sales, marketing, product, operations, and executive leadership.
  • Keep partners engaged, motivated, and accountable to the joint commercial plan.
  • Unblock issues that slow down revenue growth or damage partner confidence.
  • Run structured business reviews with clear performance insights, decisions, next steps, and ownership.
  • Ensure the partner sees Remote as a critical strategic partner, not just another integration or referral option.

Define the embedded partner GTM model across the partner portfolio

  • Define, test, and optimize sales motions across partner-sold, partner-sourced, and co-sold models. Turn successful experiments into repeatable playbooks that can be used across partners.
  • Create playbooks for demand generation, enablement, sales process, partner seller activation, deal support, QBRs, and partner performance management.
  • Advise and influence partners to implement best practices for demand generation and embedded sales in their own organizations.
  • Identify friction between channels and work with Sales, Partnerships, RevOps, and leadership to resolve it. Share learnings so that Remote gets better with every partnership, not just within one account.
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing embedded partnerships into new products, markets, customer segments, regions, or sales motions.

Manage and develop a high performing team

  • Manage a team of partner account managers and embedded sales leads supporting the partner portfolio. Set clear priorities, operating rhythms, and performance expectations for the team.
  • Coach the team to balance short-term deal support with the longer-term goal of making partner sellers more independent.

Orchestrate Remote cross-functionally

  • Act as the commercial and relationship orchestrator across Remote for the partner portfolio.
  • Work closely with Product, Solution Architecture, Partner Marketing, Solutions Consulting, Legal, Compliance, Operations, CX, Implementation, RevOps, and Partner Success.
  • Ensure internal stakeholders understand the commercial priorities, partner context, trade-offs, and urgency.
  • Escalate clearly when decisions, resources, product changes, or executive support are needed.

Practicals

  • Team: Remote Embedded
  • Reporting line: GM Remote Embedded
  • Location: North America or Western Europe. The best timezones for this role are US Eastern Time or UK time.
  • Travel: 20–40% within North America and Europe.
  • Start date: As soon as possible

Application process

Roughly 3 hours across 4 weeks

  1. Interview with recruiter
  2. Interview with future manager
  3. Interview with team members (no managers present)
  4. Prior employment verification check

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

The annual salary range for this full-time position is
$252,050—$425,300 USD

Benefits

Our full benefits & perks are explained in our handbook at . As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:
  • work from anywhere
  • flexible paid time off
  • flexible working hours (we are async)
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • budget towards co-working spaces, learning and wellness (including gym memberships)
  • mental health support services
  • stock options
  • home office budget & IT equipment

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at .

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

How to apply

  1. Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.
  2. We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote.
  3. If you don’t have an up to date CV but you are still interested in talking to us, please feel free to add a copy of your LinkedIn profile instead.

Not only do we encourage folks from all ethnic groups, genders, sexuality, age, abilities, disability status and any other under-represented group to apply, but we prioritize a sense of belonging. We have 4 ERGs (Women, Disability, Queer, Minorities in Tech) who meet regularly with the People team. During your interviews and beyond, we ask & encourage anybody who needs an accommodation to request one from their recruiter.

We will ask you to voluntarily tell us your pronouns at interview stage, and you will have the option to answer our anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply below. As an equal employment opportunity employer it’s important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and this data will help us to stay accountable. We thank you for providing this data, if you chose to.

At Remote, we embrace AI as a valuable tool while prioritizing human creativity and authenticity. We look forward to meeting candidates who balance innovation with genuine expertise and experience. To learn more about Remote's AI guidelines check see here.

Please note we accept applications on an ongoing basis.

raw.description:
Implementation Manager

Location: Remote

Commercial Real Estate ("CRE") is one of the world's largest asset classes, yet the documents that govern it — leases, amendments, and agreements running thousands of pages — remain locked in formats that are slow to read, easy to misinterpret and nearly impossible to act on at scale. The critical terms buried inside these documents define revenue, risk and capital, but even the most sophisticated owners, operators and investors struggle to turn them into intelligence they can trust.

Founded in 2018, Prophia transforms the documents that govern commercial real estate into verified intelligence — combining AI-powered extraction with expert human validation to deliver data our customers can rely on. That trusted data helps owners, operators and investors uncover risk, protect capita and make sharper decisions across leasing, acquisitions, asset management and investor reporting. Today Prophia stewards the largest private CRE dataset in the world — more than 648 million square feet across 5,200+ buildings, 200,000+ documents, and nearly 25,000 tenants — and is backed by leading investors including SignalFire and Cercano. We operate as a distributed team, with employees located across the country and hubs in the San Francisco Bay Area and Seattle.

About the Role:

Providing an outstanding implementation experience for customers is essential to their long term success with Prophia. During this critical phase, Implementation Managers are responsible for onboarding customer data with the highest level of accuracy. This process includes thorough reviews of AI-extracted data points, using in-app features to communicate with customers, demonstrating product and lease language expertise and meeting SLAs.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Manage the process of extracting critical data from tenant documents for new and existing customers accurately and in a timely manner
  • Review, confirm, and reconcile customer data in the Prophia platform, meeting specified deadlines and performance metrics
  • Leverage AI tools and internal automation to improve productivity, data quality, communication, documentation, and project execution
  • Continuously identify opportunities to incorporate AI into daily workflows to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and increase implementation efficiency.
  • Demonstrate project management excellence including the ability to keep stakeholders on track (i.e., outsourced onboarding support), manage issues and risks through resolution, and ensure milestones are met
  • Become an expert in commercial lease language and use problem-solving skills to interpret landlord and tenant rights
  • Follow and iterate on best practices during the implementation processes throughout the customer journey
  • Provide an exceptional onboarding experience to customers, ensuring users are able to maximize the value of Prophia for their organizations
  • Lead onboarding calls with customers to provide a high level product overview and reconcile any data discrepancies
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to manage objectives, scope and timeline for new and ongoing implementations of Prophia services
  • Communicate product feedback and product bugs to the Product, Engineering, and AI teams

Qualifications:

  • Highly detail-oriented with a strong commitment to data accuracy and quality
  • Excellent communication, follow-through and follow-up skills, with a proven ability to meet commitments and deadlines
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to set priorities, manage multiple projects and deliver results in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills, including the ability to break down complex or ambiguous issues into manageable solutions
  • Comfortable learning and leveraging new technologies to improve customer outcomes and operational efficiency
  • Ability to maintain a positive attitude and calm demeanor, especially in escalated situations
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in commercial real estate, lease administration, or lease abstraction
  • Or alternatively, experience in multifamily property management, residential real estate operations or another related real estate industry
  • Experience working in a startup or other high-growth, rapidly changing environment
  • Familiarity with AI productivity tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Gemini) and an interest in using AI to improve documentation, communication, project management, and operational efficiency

Compensation for this role is comprised of an annual salary ranging between $85,000-$100,000 as well as equity and benefits. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications and experience.

Next Steps:

If you think we may be a good fit for each other, we encourage you to apply! We will get back to you within a week. If we move forward, here is our typical interview process.

  1. A 30 minute phone call with a member of Prophia’s People Team to understand your high-level background and to discuss logistics and expectations.
  2. A 45 minute video call with the hiring manager for the role to dig deeper into your background, relevant skills and early stage startup and/or CRE experience.
  3. A virtual onsite final round! This stage includes 4-5 interviews with other members of the team focused on Prophia’s company values and how you would demonstrate them if you were to join the organization.

We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity compensation
  • An amazing team and work environment
  • Comprehensive health, dental and vision care for you and your family
  • Retirement plan (401K)
  • Flexible time off policy and paid holidays
  • Generous paid family, medical and bereavement leave policies
  • Freedom to customize your work and technology set-up as you see fit; flexibility of location

---

Prophia is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identify, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the US. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.

raw.description:
Job Description:

About Us

Flui Technologies is a leading software solution provider to the energy and water sector, delivering innovative and scalable software infrastructure and services since 1990. Our solutions - MarketFlow, MeterFlow and DCC adapter - support market competition, smart metering, network flexibility and supplier integration across Energy Retail, Energy Networks and Water Retail, and are used to manage messaging for more than 35 million electricity and gas meter points, with millions of records processed per day.

As the utility sector evolves to meet the challenges of Net Zero, Smart Metering, Energy Code reform, Market-wide Half-Hourly Settlement, Demand-side Response and Embedded Generation, we combine deep industry knowledge with technical innovation to deliver robust, business-focused solutions backed by dedicated people and exceptional support. We are certified to ISO/IEC 27001:2022, reflecting our commitment to protecting data and managing risk.

The Role

The Head of Cloud Platform Engineering owns the operations and component-level architecture of Flui's AWS cloud estate - the infrastructure that underpins software processing critical market and metering data at national scale. This is a hands-on role: you will design, build and run cloud-native platforms combining AWS-native services with open-source components, and carry end-to-end accountability for how that estate performs, costs, and stands up to scrutiny.

Beyond architecture and operations, you will own FinOps and security for the cloud estate, and act as the accountable owner for its overall fitness for purpose - resilience, performance and scalability - as Flui's platforms scale to support a growing and increasingly complex utility market. You will work closely with the engineering leadership to ensure architecture decisions serve both the product roadmap and the operational realities of running critical infrastructure.

The role suits someone who wants to remain genuinely hands-on with design and build, while holding single-point accountability for how well the cloud estate is run, secured and paid for.

Job Responsibilities

The Head of Cloud Platform Engineering will report to the Technology Director and will be responsible for:

  • Owning the component-level architecture of Flui's AWS cloud estate, spanning AWS-native services and open-source/self-managed components (e.g. container orchestration, messaging, data stores, observability tooling).

  • Operating and continuously improving the platforms underpinning MarketFlow, MeterFlow and DCC adapter, with direct accountability for their resilience, performance and scalability at national-scale transaction volumes.

  • Designing and maintaining disaster recovery, high-availability and capacity plans appropriate to platforms supporting critical utility market infrastructure.

  • Owning FinOps for the cloud estate: cost visibility, forecasting, tagging and allocation, and driving measurable, ongoing cost optimisation without compromising reliability.

  • Owning cloud security posture: identity and access management, network security, encryption, vulnerability and patch management, and ensuring the estate operates in line with Flui's ISO/IEC 27001 ISMS and wider compliance obligations.

  • Defining and maintaining the non-functional standards ('fitness for purpose') that platforms must meet - resilience, performance, scalability and observability - and holding engineering teams to them through architecture review and guardrails.

  • Remaining hands-on: designing, building and, where appropriate, personally implementing infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines and platform tooling alongside the wider engineering team.

  • Owning operational rigor for the estate - incident management, on-call practice, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement of SRE practices.

  • Making and owning build-vs-buy and AWS-native-vs-open-source decisions, balancing cost, control, operability and vendor lock-in.

  • Managing key vendor and technical relationships, including AWS itself and providers of critical open-source or commercial platform tooling.

  • Partnering with the product/engineering leadership to ensure cloud architecture decisions support the product roadmap and time-to-market, and recruiting/developing a small, high-calibre platform engineering team as the estate grows.

  • Championing knowledge sharing and technical education across engineering - documenting architecture decisions and standards, running internal sessions on cloud and platform practice, and mentoring engineers and technical colleagues to raise the wider team's capability.

Essential Competencies and Experience

Business Acumen

  • Demonstrable experience owning cloud platforms supporting a regulated, high-availability or critical-infrastructure business.

  • Ability to balance technical excellence with commercial and operational reality - cost, risk, and delivery pace.

  • Understanding of the utility/energy sector's data and resilience expectations is an advantage.

Cloud Architecture & Platform Engineering

  • Deep, hands-on AWS expertise across compute, storage, networking, data and security services, ideally evidenced by current AWS certification(s).

  • Proven experience designing and operating cloud-native platforms that combine AWS-native services with open-source components (e.g. Kubernetes, Terraform, Kafka or equivalent messaging, Prometheus/Grafana or equivalent observability).

  • Track record of owning a FinOps practice and delivering demonstrable, sustained cloud cost savings.

  • Strong cloud security background - IAM, encryption, vulnerability management - and familiarity with compliance frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001.

  • Experience defining and meeting non-functional requirements: high availability, disaster recovery, performance/load testing and scalability at production scale.

General

  • Strong infrastructure-as-code skills (Terraform, CloudFormation or CDK) and mature CI/CD practice.

  • Comfortable operating hands-on day to day while also owning strategy, standards and team development.

  • A track record of sharing knowledge and raising technical capability across a team or wider engineering community - through documentation, mentoring, or internal training.

  • Willingness to participate in on-call/incident response as needed for platforms supporting critical services.

Job Qualifications

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline is a bonus, or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Current AWS certification(s) - e.g. Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional or Security Specialty - highly desirable.

Your Personal Characteristics Will Include

  • A pragmatic engineer-leader: hands-on by instinct, comfortable balancing strategic ownership with keyboard time.

  • Security and cost-conscious by default, without losing sight of reliability and delivery speed.

  • Calm and structured under pressure, with a methodical approach to incident response.

  • Curious and current - actively tracks the evolving cloud and open-source ecosystem.

  • Advocates simplicity and resists unnecessary complexity or over-engineering.

  • A clear communicator, able to translate technical trade-offs into business terms for the leadership team.

  • A natural teacher and mentor, who enjoys raising the technical capability of colleagues and peers, not just delivering the work themselves.

Jonas Software is a leading provider of enterprise management software solutions, serving a wide range of vertical markets including hospitality, healthcare, construction, education, personal care, fitness, leisure, moving and legal services, to name a few. Within these markets, Jonas is comprised of over 65 distinct brands, each a respected leader in its domain.

Jonas’ vision is to be the branded global leader across these verticals and to be recognized by customers and industry stakeholders as the trusted provider of “Software for Life.” We are committed to technology, product innovation, quality, and exceptional customer service.

Jonas Software supports over 60,000 customers in more than 30 countries. We employ over 6,000 skilled professionals, including industry experts and technology specialists. Across our broader network, we support a global workforce of more than 30,000 employees.

Headquartered in Canada, Jonas Software has a global footprint with offices around the world. We’re a 100% owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., based in Toronto, publicly listed on the TSX (CSU.TO), and a member of the S&P/TSX 60 Index.

About Bryant Park Consulting:

Bryant Park Consulting is a leading Oracle | NetSuite consulting firm dedicated to helping businesses achieve their goals through successful ERP implementations and optimizations. We are a team of experienced consultants passionate about delivering exceptional client service and driving digital transformation. At Bryant Park Consulting, we foster a collaborative and supportive environment where our employees can thrive and grow professionally.

Role Overview:

The Billing and Vendor Coordinator plays a critical operational role within the Finance & Accounting team at Bryant Park Consulting. This position serves as the central point of coordination between Sales, Operations, and Finance — responsible for reviewing and processing client and subcontractor Statements of Work (SOWs), maintaining accurate rate cards, and managing the end-to-end onboarding of both clients and vendors into the company’s financial systems. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working across multiple systems and stakeholders in a fast-paced professional services environment.

Key Responsabilities:

Client Contracts & Onboarding:

  • Review incoming client Statements of Work (SOWs) for accuracy, completeness, and alignment with agreed commercial terms prior to execution.
  • Enter and maintain client rate cards in the company’s ERP system (NetSuite), ensuring billing rates are correctly mapped to project codes, service lines, and contract terms.
  • Coordinate the full client onboarding process, including setting up client records, payment terms, billing schedules, and project structures in NetSuite.
  • Partner with Sales and Account Management to ensure all contract details are accurately captured before work commences.
  • Flag discrepancies, missing information, or non-standard terms to the Director of Finance & Accounting for review and resolution.
  • Maintain an organized, up-to-date repository of executed client contracts and supporting documentation.

Subcontractor Contracts & Onboarding:

  • Review subcontractor Statements of Work and vendor agreements for completeness, rate accuracy, and compliance with internal margin and approval thresholds.
  • Onboard new subcontractors into NetSuite, including vendor record setup, payment terms, W-9 and tax documentation collection, and banking information verification.
  • Maintain and update subcontractor rate cards, ensuring costs are accurately reflected in the billing system and reconciled against SOW commitments.
  • Coordinate with Operations and Project Management teams to align subcontractor assignments with active project codes and budget allocations.
  • Monitor subcontractor onboarding status and proactively communicate timelines to internal stakeholders to prevent delays to project start dates.

Billing Operations & System Maintenance:

  • Ensure all rate cards, billing schedules, and contract terms are accurately and promptly entered into NetSuite to support timely and accurate invoicing.
  • Perform regular audits of client and vendor records in NetSuite to identify and correct data integrity issues.
  • Support the month-end close process by confirming that billing data is complete, reconciled, and ready for revenue recognition.
  • Assist the Director of Finance & Accounting in preparing billing reports, contract summaries, and pipeline tracking dashboards.
  • Identify opportunities to improve and standardize SOW intake, rate card entry, and onboarding workflows to reduce cycle time and manual effort.

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact between Finance, Sales, Operations, and HR for all contract intake and onboarding-related inquiries.
  • Communicate proactively with internal teams regarding contract status, onboarding milestones, and any blockers requiring resolution.
  • Support compliance efforts by ensuring vendor documentation (W-9s, insurance certificates, signed agreements) is collected and stored in accordance with company policy.
  • Assist with special projects and process improvement initiatives as directed by the Director of Finance & Accounting.

Skills and Qualifications:

Required:

  • Experience in a billing, contracts, operations, or finance coordination role, preferably within a professional services environment.
  • Demonstrated experience reviewing and processing contracts or Statements of Work.
  • Proficiency with ERP or accounting systems; NetSuite experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy in data entry and record-keeping.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Clear and professional communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to work effectively across teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the broader Microsoft Office / Google Workspace suite.

Preferred:

  • Experience with subcontractor or vendor onboarding, including W-9 collection and vendor record setup.
  • Familiarity with professional services billing models including time-and-materials, fixed-fee, and rate card structures.
  • Exposure to revenue recognition concepts and month-end close support activities.
  • Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

Work From Home & Travel Requirements

  • Fully remote
This role is open to candidates based anywhere in Latin America.

Putting Our People First From Day One

From the founding of Bryant Park Consulting, we committed to putting people first and offering variety, fulfillment, and balance. You will have the opportunity to work with the world's top companies and business leaders, keep up with the latest technology, and flex your skills across industries and disciplines. You will also be encouraged to engage with your community and nature. We attract and retain the best in the business - people from industry, consulting, agencies, startups, nonprofits, and the public sector - all drawn to building a career that's both exciting and sustainable.

  • Feed Your Curiosity - Foster technical and industry expertise, and grow as a leader. Knowledge management and professional development are held in highest regard, we offer and sponsor flexible learning options on topics from Project Management to Web Development, and we pay for certifications with top programs.
  • Cultivate Well Being - Thrive holistically with a robust and personalized set of benefits and company resources to support your emotional, mental, financial, physical, and social well-being. Celebrate with your team or explore interests with other team members, from book clubs to speaking events and annual retreats.
  • Choose Your Career - There is no pressure to go ‘up-or-out’ and welcome you to build a career that gets you excited about coming to work every day - whether that’s as an individual contributor or a team manager. Performance is evaluated fairly and regularly and as the organization grows we expect you and your career to grow with us.
  • Comprehensive Benefits - We provide best-in-class benefits for employees including 401k with Company match up to 6%, United Health Plan, as well as Dental, Vision, Life Insurance and Accidental Death and Dismemberment, and more. We also encourage and reimburse for costs of approved training, continuing education, skills development, and professional certification programs and exams to help further your career development.

raw.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Technical Project Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of web and app development projects, including ongoing support and maintenance engagements.

The ideal candidate combines strong project management and delivery skills with a solid technical background and experience managing software development projects. This role requires someone who can work closely with Engineering and QA teams, understand technical requirements and dependencies, challenge estimates and timelines when needed, and ensure projects are delivered successfully.

The role operates in an evolving environment where structure exists but may require strengthening. The ideal candidate takes full accountability for delivery outcomes, proactively drives projects forward, and effectively manages technical risks, dependencies, and blockers.

While overall client ownership remains at senior level, this Technical Project Manager will lead client calls, manage project reporting, coordinate UAT, and serve as the primary driver of day-to-day technical delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Project Ownership & Delivery

  • Own end-to-end delivery of web and app development projects.
  • Manage project planning, sprint planning, execution, and closure with Development and QA teams.
  • Drive timely sprint completion and minimize spillover.
  • Ensure clear understanding of technical scope, deliverables, requirements, and acceptance criteria.
  • Translate business and client requirements into clear deliverables for technical teams.
  • Maintain delivery momentum across parallel technical workstreams.
  • Monitor project progress against timelines, scope, quality, and dependencies.

Technical Risk & Issue Management

  • Proactively identify technical risks, blockers, and dependencies that may impact delivery.
  • Work closely with Engineering and QA teams to investigate issues and drive resolution.
  • Challenge technical estimates, timelines, and dependencies when required.
  • Identify root causes of delays and implement mitigation plans.
  • Escalate technical and delivery risks early with clear recommendations and action plans.
  • Track cross-team and technical dependencies throughout the project lifecycle.

Client-Facing Responsibilities

  • Lead client status calls and technical delivery discussions.
  • Present structured project progress updates, risks, dependencies, and action items.
  • Translate technical updates into clear and understandable client-facing communication.
  • Own UAT coordination, including entry/exit criteria, issue tracking, and closure.
  • Manage support ticket tracking, prioritization, and resolution follow-up.
  • Maintain clear and professional communication with enterprise and demanding clients.

Technical Collaboration

  • Work closely with developers, QA engineers, and other technical stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Understand software development processes, architectures, integrations, APIs, and technical dependencies sufficiently to engage effectively with engineering teams.
  • Participate in technical discussions and help translate technical decisions into project plans and delivery actions.
  • Ensure technical requirements and dependencies are clearly understood and tracked.
  • Support realistic estimation and planning by understanding technical complexity and resource requirements.
  • Facilitate communication between technical teams, business stakeholders, and clients.

Requirements

    • 3+ years of experience in Technical Project Management or Digital Project Management, preferably within web or app development.
    • Proven experience managing software development projects from planning through delivery.
    • Experience working closely with Development and QA teams in Agile or hybrid environments.
    • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
    • Solid technical understanding of web/mobile applications, APIs, integrations, databases, and common software development concepts.
    • Ability to understand and actively participate in technical discussions with engineers and technical stakeholders.
    • Ability to assess technical dependencies, challenge timelines/estimates, and identify potential delivery risks.
    • Experience working with enterprise or demanding clients.
    • Strong ownership mindset with a proven track record of driving technical delivery outcomes.
    • Strong communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and organizational skills.

Plus

    • Experience managing support and maintenance contracts.
    • Experience working with technical teams on API integrations or third-party integrations.
    • Experience with cloud-based projects or platforms.
    • Technical background in software development, engineering, QA, or a related technical field.
    • Experience with project management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.

About the role: 
Gartner Analysts are industry thought leaders who create must-have insights, market predictions and best practices for a broad range of world-leading organizations. A Director serves as a leader within Gartner’s Business and Technology Insights (BTI) group, establishing oneself as a credible voice within their designated market at local, regional and global levels. Utilizing exceptional research and analytical skills, a Director plays a significant role in producing pragmatic and provocative insights which Gartner clients consume and apply to propel their business toward key objectives. They are a trusted source of advice for clients, reinforcing Gartner’s value every day by engaging them via in-person meetings, virtual meetings, sales support visits and Gartner conferences to discuss complex client challenges and offer appropriate recommendations. 

 

A Director possesses a keen eye for identifying gaps, problems and solutions within the market they serve. They use their knowledge to help clients make better decisions, solve complex issues and execute new practices that propel clients’ businesses toward key objectives and publish these pragmatic and/or provocative insights. Additionally, they reinforce Gartner’s value every day by engaging clients via in-person and virtual meetings, sales support visits, Gartner conferences and industry events. This role is an opportunity to join Gartner’s growing Human Resources Practice. This group is dedicated to tracking the leading edge of HR innovation — notably the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on HR and the workforce — and advising Chief Human Resources Officers (CHROs) and other HR functional leaders on related HR strategies, initiatives and investments.  Senior Directors are expected to offer flexibility in what they can cover and how they channel their expertise. 
 
What you will do:  

  • Create innovative, thought provoking, and highly leveraged “must-have” insights offering compelling, objective and actionable advice for Gartner clients in multiple formats (i.e., writing, video, infographics, podcasts) on topics including (but not limited to) focusing on AI in HR strategy creation, use case implementation, workflow redesign, governance, and value realization 

  • Develop new insights and ideas through thought leadership and offer compelling, actionable approaches to client's needs and requests that accelerate the client's ability to act 

  • Develop in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of a client’s barriers or overall needs and reframe thinking to drive strategy forward 

  • Demonstrate thought leadership in establishing insights positions across a team of analysts 

  • Bring provocative, independent insights into Gartner leaders that can evolve the course of a research agenda 

  • Research, analyze and predict market trends and shifts, including relevant regulatory environments, to provide clients and vendors with actionable insights; track and work closely with vendors, market trends, emerging technologies and practices to remain ahead of the curve within the AI-driven HR technology space 

  • Deliver individualized advice rooted in quantitative and qualitative data and specific to a client role to CHROs and other senior HR leaders through video-based presentations and discussions 

  • Create and deliver high value presentation materials on and off stage for Gartner events, industry and professional association conferences, and client briefings 

  • Support BTI and Sales: Provide sales support serving as voice of the market to help Insights teams create content and to drive engagement with clients to make progress against their critical priorities to grow their business 

  • Provide high quality and timely content peer review 

  • Build credibility as an industry expert to represent Gartner insights, methodology and strategy 

  • Actively participate in innovation, ideation, and research discussions and collaborate effectively with peers in the Insights community 

  • Identify research process improvements or develop new processes that help the team and BTI provide excellent service delivery 

  • Be a mentor and a coach by supporting more junior team members 

  • Be client-centric while actively seeking to help clients engage regularly and often with Gartner insights and interactions 

   

What you will need:  

  • Bachelor's degree and 10+ years of relevant field or industry experience in HR functional and/or technology leadership roles or an equivalent combination of education and experience

  • Profound understanding of the challenges CHROs face as leaders within the enterprise and familiarity with the CHRO workflows and priorities. 

  • Experience with successfully designing, implementing and managing HR AI in HR strategies and transformation initiatives. 

  • Deep first-hand knowledge of the HR tech landscape, including market dynamics, vendors, products and emerging use cases, particularly with respect to AI and generative AI, and their impact on HR strategies, use cases, processes workflows, team structures and data governance, and ROI governance. 

  • HR compliance experience, specifically understanding how relevant regulatory environments impact HR operations  

  • Demonstrate executive presence; can immediately establish credibility with executives and additional stakeholders 

  • Strong organizational skills; ability to work under tight deadlines and produce high-quality deliverables 

  • Demonstrate excellence in research and writing ability 

  • Strong written and verbal proficiency, analytical and presentation skills; ability to engage clients and respond effectively to questions 

  • Proficient in analyzing and synthesizing data; can effectively apply patterns and frameworks while drawing and defending conclusions to client challenges 

  • Strong communicator who can explain complex concepts concisely and simply 

  • Subject matter expert comfortable presenting at large and small-scale speaking engagements 

  • Strong business and financial acumen 

  • Deep knowledge of the global and competitive landscape within subject area as well as the interplay in that market 

  • Ability to work independently, while also being intrinsically motivated to collaborate across teams and support the workflow of others, in a multicultural global team 

  • Learning agile and adept with navigating highly matrixed environments 

  • Ability to represent Gartner's research methodology and strategies effectively at all levels 

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% (where applicable) 

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend/Infra)

raw.title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend/Infra)
raw.excerpt: En Fintual hacemos que las inversiones sean simples, transparentes y al alcance de todas las personas.
raw.description:
En Fintual hacemos que las inversiones sean simples, transparentes y al alcance de todas las personas.
Nacimos con la idea de que cualquiera, sin importar el dinero que tenga, pueda invertir bien sus ahorros y hacer crecer su patrimonio. La mitad de nuestros clientes dice que antes de Fintual no tenía experiencia administrando su dinero, por eso el reto es mostrarles cómo pueden hacerlo y ayudarles a convertirlo en un hábito.
Además, somos la primera startup en Hispanoamérica en lanzar sus propios fondos para invertir y la primera AGF en Chile en conectarse al Centro de Compensaciones Automatizadas para salir en la lista de transferencias de los bancos.
Queremos sumar un Software Engineer que disfrute meterse en sistemas y entender cómo funcionan de verdad. Esta persona se sumaría a nuestro squad de Back, encargado de construir y mantener la infraestructura y sistemas base que sostienen los productos de Fintual, enfocándose en escalabilidad, confiabilidad, seguridad y operación.

Qué harías?

    Trabajarías en la base sobre la que corren nuestros productos.

    Eso significa meterte en cosas como:

  • Cómo desplegamos y operamos servicios
  • Cómo diseñamos sistemas que no se caigan (o que se recuperen rápido)
  • Cómo construimos un producto seguro
  • Cómo hacemos debugging cuando algo falla en producción
  • Cómo mejoramos performance, latencia y uso de recursos
  • Cómo hacemos que desarrollar y operar sea más simple para el resto del equipo

    • Gran parte de lo que construyas no se va a ver.

    Pero va a impactar a todos.

Qué tipo de problemas vas a resolver?

    De todo un poco, algunos ejemplos:

  • manejar concurrencia y consistencia
  • entender cuellos de botella reales
  • balancear el salir rápido vs la deuda técnica
  • armar un esquema de autenticación para usuarios y entre servicios
  • diseñar sistemas que escalen sin volverse inmanejables
  • tomar decisiones con trade-offs (y hacerse cargo de ellas)

Lo que buscamos

    Alguien que disfrute meterse en sistemas y entender cómo funcionan de verdad.

  • Has trabajado con backend en producción
  • Has estado cerca de infraestructura (deploys, cloud, observabilidad, etc.)
  • Te sientes cómodo/a debuggeando problemas reales
  • Puedes moverte con autonomía

    • No nos importa tanto si usas X lenguaje o Y framework.

    Sí nos importa cómo piensas.

Stack

    No necesitas calzar perfecto con todo esto, pero para que tengas contexto:

  • Lenguajes: principalmente Ruby, Python y Go
  • Infraestructura: AWS, Cloudflare, un poquito de GCP
  • Contenedores: Docker
  • Orquestación: Kubernetes
  • CI/CD: Github Actions, ArgoCD
  • Observabilidad: logs, métricas y tracing (Prometheus / OTEL, Grafana, Loki, Thanos, Tempo, Alloy)
  • Bases de datos: PostgreSQL, Redis

Cómo trabajamos

  • Equipos chicos
  • Alta autonomía
  • Poca burocracia
  • Conversaciones técnicas de verdad

    • No hay mucho espacio para “esto no es mi problema”.

Este rol es para ti si...

  • Te gusta entender cómo funcionan las cosas por debajo
  • Disfrutas arreglar problemas difíciles
  • Te importa que los sistemas sean sólidos, no solo que funcionen

Cómo es el proceso?

    Antes de aplicar a la postulación, debes realizar una tarea que debiera tomarte unas 2-6 horas dependiendo de cuánto quieras avanzar, luego al postular tendrás que adjuntar el link de repositorio de GitHub, Gitfront.io, u otro, con la respuesta. El código base y las tareas a realizar están aquí:

    Pasada la revisión del código, estas son las etapas:
  • Screening (30 min) con TL y/o CTO + People para conocerte y contarte más del cargo.
  • Entrevista técnica (50 min) en la que tendrás que programar en vivo algo que te pidamos.
  • Conversación (30 min) con un integrante del equipo.
  • Chequeo de referencias laborales.
    • 👩🏻‍💻 Sabías que si eres mujer estás dentro del 35% de la población que estudió alguna carrera STEM? En nuestra experiencia, las mujeres postulan a menos cargos que los hombres si ven que no cumplen con todos los requisitos. Así que si lo estás dudando, no lo pienses tanto.

Compensación salarial

    Una vez pases la entrevista técnica, definiremos en qué nivel técnico te vemos y según ese nivel es que preparamos la oferta salarial. Para que tengas una idea, para este rol buscamos:
  • Level 4 (desde 4500 USD)
    • *Los rangos pueden variar según tu experiencia y el salario se paga en moneda local del país contratante (Chile o México).

raw.description:
Application Security Engineer

Parallels is seeking a highly motivated and talented Application Security Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will make security decisions that impact millions of our customers while gaining hands-on experience in exploit development and CVE discovery. The ideal candidate will combine an attacker mindset with the humility and detail-oriented attitude required to coordinate fixes and security architecting with busy engineers.

Your primary responsibility will be to coordinate with more senior members of our team to write exploits and design fixes for existing application vulnerabilities. You will also help search for new critical/high risk vulnerabilities in our codebase. In addition, you will assist in vulnerability disclosure processes and help implement repeatable secure development practices.

As issues are uncovered, you will communicate with the appropriate technical and leadership teams to ensure a focus on risk mitigation – allowing for business continuity, but without negligent risk. Application security engineers are constantly assessing applications for weaknesses and finding resolutions before they can be abused.

Parallels: anytime, anywhere, any-device productivity.Why Parallels, why now?

The top creative and technical minds could sell anywhere. So why are so many choosing Parallels? Three reasons:

This is the moment.It's an exciting time at Parallels — strong leadership, a refreshed brand, and a whole new approach to how the world works. The EUC market is shifting fast, and we're at the front of that wave. We want you riding it with us.

We want you to be you.Too many companies tell you about their culture and then expect you to fit it. Ours is built from the people who work here. We want you to feel safe being who you are, taking risks, and showing us what you've got.

It's your world.We know you have a life. We want to be part of it — not all of it. At Parallels, we're serious about empowering people to work when, how, and where they want. Couch? Sweatpants? Cool with us. Happy sellers mean happy customers. That's why we hire amazing people and get out of their way.

Sound good so far? Awesome. Let's talk about the role

What you'll do:

  • Reproduce and triage incoming vulnerabilities from security automation/bug bounty programs, then propose granular fixes to engineers
  • Discover vulnerabilities and construct exploits for core Parallels applications such as Parallels Remote Application Server
  • Assist in the CVE disclosure process
  • Provide threat models and design reviews for teams throughout the company
  • Assist in tuning existing static analysis, dynamic analysis, and dependency management tools

📣 Calling all Philadelphia-based Professional Engineers looking to pivot into Climate & Energy 📣

Role Description:

The Project Engineer role centers on strategically deploying it’s electric’s unique model of curbside charging infrastructure in Philadelphia.

Responsibilities include:

  • Overall project management for charger deployments
  • Site assessment and evaluation, including available power capacity
  • Overall project design and engineering, including drawings and specifications
  • Signing and stamping permit drawings to local authorities
  • Coordination with local permit authorities and utilities

• Contractor bid and award

  • Construction administration and coordination
  • Evolving and expanding company-wide technical and strategic standards

  • Management of technical sub-consultants
  • Coordination with it’s electric project managers and designers across regions

Requirements

Candidate Requirements:

We seek highly motivated candidates with 5 to 10 years of experience in electrical engineering. Candidates should have examples of complex urban design and build projects (extra points if in urban rights-of-way) that have been physically built and are in use. Experience deploying EV charging is not a requirement; however, all candidates should be knowledgeable about electrical distribution systems in cities and buildings. Candidates should be familiar with and comfortable interpreting NFPA 70 (NEC) and the National Electric Safety Code.

Strong candidates will have experience seeing complex projects through from concept to completion. Candidates should be comfortable using traditional collaborative drafting and diagramming tools (AutoCAD, Bluebeam) and be able to clearly convey engineering principles using non-technical language. Candidates will have experience working with trades and contractors during the construction and sign-off phases, and will be able to contribute to the development and ongoing maintenance of project tracking and documentation tools and assets.

As this is a fully remote role, candidates are expected to be highly autonomous, comfortable with occasional ambiguity, able to manage time effectively, and effective communicators (erring on the side of over-communication). Candidates should demonstrate the ability to thrive without direct daily supervision, and be highly organized to independently advance projects. As such, the engineer will make engineering calculations to prepare engineering designs and specifications; prepare plans and drawings neatly and accurately to it’s electric’s guidelines; deal effectively with contractors, property owners and the general public; understand and interpret engineering as-builts; and ensure project compliance with State, Federal, and local rules, laws and regulations, including as set by the local utility.

it’s electric is a rapidly growing start-up, and we are looking for candidates willing to embrace the challenges and excitement inherent in a growing company. The role will challenge candidates to work with new technology, develop novel processes, and implement standard procedures that develop over time. Candidates must demonstrate the capacity to build and maintain productive, positive, and long-term relationships with stakeholders, while proactively and assertively tending the permitting, technical, and highly targeted project schedule.

Only Licensed Professional Engineers, or engineers who have completed their Engineer-in-Training programs will be considered for this role. Licensed PE is strongly preferred. Professional license must be maintained as a condition of employment.

Physical Requirements:

Candidates must be able to lift equipment (up to 40 pounds) as necessary. This position is fully remote; however, candidates should have flexibility to travel for local meetings in person as needed, as well as to it’s electric’s headquarters in Brooklyn (also as needed).

The salary range for this role is $150K-$160K, depending on length and relevance of candidate’s experience.

raw.description:
Who are we?

Ensono is a global technology services provider dedicated to helping organizations navigate the complexity of digital transformation. Through Ensono Product, Consulting & Technology, our dedicated consulting arm, we partner with clients to design, build, and modernize digital capabilities across application development and modernization, data platforms and AI, and identity and access management. As we continue to expand our global consulting footprint, we are committed to delivering innovative, high‑quality outcomes that enable our clients to move faster, smarter, and more securely.

About the role and what you'll be doing:

As a Senior DevOps Consultant, you’ll be a key technical contributor in delivering complex projects — combining deep engineering skills with the confidence to work independently within your area of responsibility. You’ll take end-to-end ownership of your deliverables, ensuring they meet high standards of quality, security, and performance, while collaborating closely with colleagues and client teams to achieve project goals.

Working within a cross‑functional environment, you’ll apply modern DevOps practices to design, build, and optimise solutions that help clients get the most from their cloud platform.

You’ll be actively involved throughout the full project lifecycle — from refining requirements and influencing solutions, to delivering working systems and communicating outcomes to technical and non‑technical audiences. You’ll also provide guidance and informal mentoring to less experienced engineers, helping to raise capability within the team.

When not delivering on a client engagement, you may contribute to pre‑sales activities such as analysing technical requirements, working with our bid team, and helping develop compelling proposals. You’ll also have opportunities to engage with Ensono Digital’s internal competencies — sharing knowledge, refining our delivery approaches, and expanding your own expertise.

We value consultants who take ownership of their work, are proactive in developing themselves, and look for ways to add value for both clients and colleagues.

Experience you’llbring:

CI/CD & Automation

  • Designing and building advanced CI/CD pipelines from scratch using two or more platforms such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab.
  • Creating reusable pipeline templates (e.g., Azure DevOps templates, GitHub Actions reusable workflows, and infrastructure modules (e.g., Terraform)
  • Integrating automated quality checks, testing, and security scanning into pipelines

Infrastructure as Code & Cloud

  • Hands-on commercial experience with at least one of the major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Implementing Infrastructure as Code solutions using tools like Terraform, or cloud native tooling (ARM/Bicep, CloudFormation)

Kubernetes, Containerisation & Networking

  • Designing, deploying, and operating Kubernetes clusters for production workloads at scale
  • Configuring application routing using CDN, load balancers, and ingress controllers for single and multi‑region architectures
  • Knowledge of hub‑and‑spoke network architectures and their application in cloud environments
  • Experience working with containerised applications hosted locally and on cloud native PaaS services – e.g. Azure Container Apps, AWS ECS Fargate.

Security, Quality & Testing

  • Supporting security architecture and contributing to the definition of naming conventions, patterns, and practices
  • Identifying and implementing, build pipelines to validate non‑functional requirements (e.g., performance, security, compliance)
  • Writing and maintaining tests for infrastructure code within an existing framework
  • Analysing security scan results, particularly Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) reports

Development & Debugging

  • Debugging and troubleshooting applications in one or more languages such as Java, C#, or Node.js
  • Preferred background in software development, with the ability to apply development principles and engineering practices.

Ways of Working & Collaboration

  • Effectively resolving technical challenges on complex projects and delivering quality outcomes within your scope of work
  • Strong communication skills, including presenting technical solutions, collaborating in cross‑functional teams, and engaging with stakeholders
  • Providing informal guidance and mentoring to less experienced engineers in the team

Emerging Practices

  • Awareness of how Artificial Intelligence (AI) can accelerate project tasks such as documentation, refactoring, testing, and debugging
  • Experience with AI‑assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot is desirable

What we can offer you:

We will give you a place to strive and grow, where you will have the opportunity to work on interesting, yet challenging projects. Applying your thinking to build a better world based on intelligent technologies.

This will be an extremely varied position that’s all about problem-solving and finding the right technical solutions for your client. You will be given autonomy over your work so that you will have the opportunity to shape the projects you’re working on.

We are a people-first business, which means people are at the heart of everything we do here. We offer our associates a safe environment where learning, knowledge sharing, and open communication is encouraged. Whether at one of the internal events, such as socials, competency meet-ups, hackathons or as part of one or more of our global Community Groups, such as Beautiful Brains (for the neurodiverse and curious), HERO (helping to education regarding orientation), E-Vets (Ensono veteran community) and many more we have strived to build a business where everyone feels welcomed, included, and valued.

Our benefits include:

  • Highly competitive salary
  • Prestigious sales and broader team recognition with Annual Presidents Club
  • Company equity incentive plan
  • 27 days annual leave + plus bank holidays (increasing to 30 with length of service)
  • ½ day leave for your birthday
  • Sabbatical options at 5-years & 10-years’ service
  • 5 days study leave
  • 1 day charity leave to work for a charity of your choice
  • Competitive pension
  • Private healthcare for you and your family
  • Enhanced parental leaves
  • Life and income protection
  • Payroll giving to your favorite charity
  • Coaching & mentoring opportunities
  • Additional perks such as discounted gym membership, cycle scheme, EAP and more!

If this all sounds great, we’d love to hear from you!
